Then it's a good thing we have knights to keep the darkness at bay!
How're you holdin' up, chief? Is Talon pushing you too hard?
The universe expands without limits. My colleagues are merely helping me further my own.
Aye, but... Are you happy with that?
Ah. The results have been... Inconclusive.
You know, I really used to idolize you!
I've heard that before. What made you lose faith in me, the Petras hearings?
Naw. It's the way you crawled back to Overwatch that left me scunnered.
Well... that's a new answer.
Look what's happened to Overwatch's golden boy! I liked you better dead.
Tough talk for someone with one foot in their grave.
Crawled out of it, actually. Your lot didn't dig it quite deep enough.
Best quit poking around my files, lass. You cannae out-hack Phreak firewalls.
Hard to call it "hacking" when the password is your dog's birthday.
Last night, I had an awful nightmare. My turret was attached to my head!
That's brilliant! I have a friend that could make that happen for ye!
Hmph. Some dreams ought to stay dreams.
Your spikes look just like the stalactites in Carlsbad!
Stalackety– What're you sayin' to me now?
Don't tell me you've never been spelunking!
Alright, now you've just got to be makin' up words.
You know, if you really wanted to commit to the whole spider bit, you'd get some extra legs.
That sounds... horrifying.
Sure, like you aren't already a monster.
How much did that skin mod cost you?
More than you'd be willing to pay.
The hamster would like to examine the fuel for your weapons.
Paws off, you cheeky-teethed junker!
Next time, he will steal first and ask never.
Awrite there, friend?
I am clearing my mind before the conflict ahead. Care to join me?
Nah! I'll just take a good hit to the noggin. Does the same thing!
You seem lost. Searching for your place in the world?
No. I wouldn't know where to look.
Embrace your inner conflict, and like-minded people will find you.
**sigh** I feel faint. Terran air has so little oxygen.
Have you tried taking an altitude sickness pill?
**nervous chuckle** Those are a choking hazard...
Focus on the ones my pylon can't reach. I'll take care of the rest.
Leave it to me. I will not let them out of my sight!
Can I pet your dog?
My what? Oh! Uh... it's not a dog.
But it looks like one. Is it a wolf?
...You know what? Just for you, it's a wolf.
Quit surprising me. It throws me off when you show up so suddenly.
Sorry, won't happen again... **pauses**
*Boo!*
**sigh** Stop that!
Is something on your mind? I'd be happy to lend an ear.
I would rather not. Talking's pointless.
Are you sure? I'm a great listener.
Then hear what I just said.
Lúcio, have you heard? About the winner of the football championship?
I- uh... I-I don't wanna talk about it.
It was a fluke! That yellow card was ridiculous
It's only because the ref didn't see that foul from the first half
If they just would have hit that last penalty shot
Look, I believe in my team. We'll get 'em next time
It could've been worse. At least it wasn't like that Germany game
Why do you apologize so much?
I guess there's a lot I feel sorry about. Don't you?
It doesn't matter. Anyone I would apologize to... is gone.
Ah... I know how that feels.
Don't you ever feel remorse for the pain you have caused?
Pain makes one stronger. You should know that better than anyone.
How do you work with that doctor after everything she did to you? Don't you want revenge?
Her time will come.
Little miss sunshine's back to brighten everyone's day.
Call me that again and you're a dead man walking.
Someone already beat you to that threat
Nice augments! They must have cost quite a bit.
**bitter laugh** You have no idea...
I don't care what kind of baggage you've got. Don't bring it onto the battlefield.
You're one to talk.
There hasn't been much activity in Runasapi since the lab raid.
Are you keeping tabs on me?
You're picking fights with powerful organizations. Shouldn't... *someone* watch your six?
If you're worried, don't be. I'll manage on my own.
Did you see my last information request?
I did. Aren't you taking on too much, chica?
That's for me to decide, not you.
**sigh** I'll send you the relevant details.
Seems like the virus worked. How are you holding up?
**sigh** I'm trying not to think about it.
Lo siento, chica. If there was another way, I would have found it.
Your pylon is marvelous. Efficient and beautiful.
Doesn't matter how pretty it is if I only use it in ugly situations.
I recently learned the phrase, "stop to smell the roses." It applies here, I think.
Who do I have to bother to get my hands on your pylon's blueprints?
I don't know, those files were destroyed in... an accident.
Oh, that's a shame. I'll just reverse engineer it, then!
What's the secret behind your flight mechanism?
I don't know the specifics. Something about thermodynamics, I think.
Ahh, of course! Convection currents! Why didn't I think of that?
I don't understand how you're always smiling.
Life always finds ways to get us down. But only I can choose to keep my spirits up.
Why do you dig around in the past?
How couldn't I? Every site's like a big history mystery just begging to be solved!
Everyone wants the truth until they find out what it costs.
I was trying to recreate a quipu, but the threads kept getting tangled, so I made this friendship bracelet instead! Want it?
Are you sure? What if I lose it?
I'll just have an excuse to make another!
You have killed so many. How do you live with yourself?
I stopped being weak. You should do the same.
Poor girl. There are ways to numb your pain.
That feels wrong... Would I even be the same person?
Of course not. You would be stronger.
I didn't know monkeys needed glasses.
Actually, I'm a gorilla... And a scientist.
Hey. Guinea pig. If you don't do well, I'm throwing you in the oven.
**scared hamster noise** He says he would cook you too, but you are not seasoned enough.
Are you bigger than other rats because you're from the moon?
He says, "no. Scientists did this to him."
I'm sorry. What they did to you was wrong.
Mistaking the hamster for vermin is wrong. Making him a genius was a gift.
True strength comes to those who accept their weaknesses.
That's not what I was taught.
But it is never too late to learn.
Now, if I give you this treat, you better not tell your ma, ya hear?
**meows**
Cassidy, you’re gonna teach her to beg! Aww, but she has been so good lately, hasn’t she?
You’re so cute, I could just squish you to bits!
**angry hiss**
Aww, don’t worry! I’m just pulling your tail.
**angry meow**
Intelligent, adaptable... You have the makings of a perfect test subject.
**grumbling meows**
Hm. Though an added dose of obedience would be appreciated...
How delightful to see human arrogance contradicted. By a cat, no less.
**proud purring**
The battle ahead will be perilous. Sharpen those claws, Fika!
**contented meows**
Or perhaps our enemies will change their ways when they see how cute you are.
You'd better stay out of trouble out there. Understand, recruit?
**innocent meows**
And I'll know if you've been sneaking treats between missions!
**disappointed meows**
When Brigitte first started armoring the cats, I'd hoped it was just a phase...
**meows**
**sigh** I suppose I should just be proud she stuck with her craft.
I plot for years. I forge an army worthy of carving my name across the world. And Overwatch puts a housecat in a jetpack.
**contented purrs**
What a contemptible farce.
Fika, were you playing on my desk again? You accidentally tripped my security systems!
**innocent meows**
**chuckle**Aww, it's okay. I'll find you something else to play with.
You remind me of an old friend from the Lunar Colony.
**questioning meows**
You're both smart, and cute, and love finding trouble! I hope I can introduce you to him one day.
Ain't easy, is it? Being in charge of killers and madmen.
No. But I welcome the challenge.
We got a lot in common. Shame I'm gonna kill ya someday.
**chuckle** Indeed.
Didn't I say I'd rip out your tongue if I saw you again?!
My Queen! Your voice, ever sonorous, is like a.. gentle waterfall upon my ears! **chuckle**
Right after the mission. *Mark my words.*
Yeah, the ears are next
Ha-hey! This one thinks he's a supermodel!
You're the one with legs that go on for kilometers.
Yeah, and they're for stomping on necks. Not posing in pictures!
Don't knock it until you've tried it!
How does your hair reach such impressive heights? Gel? Mousse?
Sheer willpower!
Where do I sign up for the Scrapyard?
Fresh meat, eh? Well, try not to bore me.
Was just gonna say the same.
You owe me, Malosi! Knocked out my favorite tooth when I was trying to kick you out of my city.
Whoa! Not until you apologize for all the tetanus shots I needed 'cuz of that knife.
Ha! Guess we can call it even, then.
Do you need wings to fly, or are they just... for show?
What if they're for show, and that's why I need them?
Then I think we understand each other.
Are you, on average, more mechanical or more human?
Why?
Tryna' figure out whether to scrap you for parts.
Hm. Consider the railgun before you decide.
Guessing you're in charge around here?
**laughs** What gave it away, the "Queen" in my name?
More the number of people you shouted at on the way in.
They were going soft. I could tell!
I could've run Overwatch much better than you.
And what would *you* have done differently?
I would've caught all the bad guys, then cut their heads off!
Hmm... tempting.
There's nothing about you in my files. No images, no documents... nothing.
Yeah, well, I'm-- what's the word? Starts with 'E'?
Enigmatic?
That's the one! And don't you forget it.
What's the biggest axe you could make out of hard light?
A kilometer tall. But you would not be able to wield it.
Maybe *you* wouldn't.
Oi, blinker! Up for a little competition?
I could go for a race. But... something tells me you don't fight fair...
Smart! I would'a had a knife in your back the second you got ahead.
Fun fact? The Colosseum was actually named after a giant bronze statue of Nero!
Giant bronze statue? **scoff** We named our fighting pit after a rubbish pile!
How many widows have you made? Roughly?
I do not keep track.
Well, I'm pretty sure I'm ahead.
You look like a bruiser. Wanna be my bodyguard?
Ha. I think you can take care of yourself.
Me mate Roadhog says there's a fetching price on your noggin. Not as high as the one on ours, mind you...
He said all that?
It was more like, "*Gonna turn that bloke in. Worth a heap, hurrrrrrr...*"
Thank you for the warning. And the convincing impression.
Are you and Roadhog together?
Do you ever see us apart?
No. I mean, are you a couple?
Yes! A couple of dashing rogues! Not sure what you're missing here...
Y'know, we could always use a little extra firepower. The vault doors on these banks are gettin' awful thick!
Your piggie friend not enough?
We would *never* say no to more mayhem! **laughs**
Yeah... Mako doesn't strike me as the sharing type.
It's a little dark out there.
Then let's light it up!
**laughs** This bloke gets it!
You look like a gentleman who eats his own toenails!
Why the hell would you say that to someone?
Just looking for something we might have in common...
When I look at you, I see pure unadulterated chaos.
Is it the bombs? You don't like the bombs?
Isn't it amazing that all these structures are still standing after thousands of years?!
Ooh, not so impressive when you know they were built by... *aliens!*
There weren't aliens in ancient Egypt! **sigh** Believe me, I've checked.
Rat. Say "thank you".
Ah! My most sincerest thanks to the second most intimidating person I know.
The queen sure seems to have an interest to me. S'ppose she fancies me? **chuckles** I'd hate to break her heart!
Haha! What-what was that, Fawkes? You wanna come say that to my fist?
*laughs* You're dreaming.
Peter Piper picked a pepp– no. Peter Piper pecked a– ugh!
Are you people always this loud?
Don't lump us in with him.
He's not with us.
**whispers** He's not with us!
He's uh... not with us.
You got a problem, Junker?
*chuckle*
I don’t do problems—just solutions!
**laughs** Yeah.
How many of you Overwatch people are missing an eye?
I don't need two eyes to swing a hammer!
How many of you scoundrels are missing a leg?

paths.label: I don't need two eyes to swing a hammer!
How many of you scoundrels are missing a leg?

lines.subtitles: **questioning meows**
Are you speaking to me?
**meows**
Hm... perhaps I should prioritize "cat" on my list of languages to learn.
You look nervous. Want to meditate?
I am interested, but it sounds difficult.
I'll try to walk you through it. Take a deep breath, and try to calm your thoughts...
Alright... **sigh** ...I am incompatible with this activity.
Think I can use your ring tech on my bike? I have a race coming up soon.
Would that be considered cheating?
No! Well... maybe.
**gasp** How thrilling! We will make it happen!
Auntie Mei, what did Mother do for fun?
Lots of things! Figure skating, karaoke... and, of course, partying!
Then I must learn these skills too.
You look pale, Juno. Did you skip dinner again?
Yes... I spent so long deciding what to try, that I stopped feeling hungry.
That is not a good excuse. **sighs** I'm cooking for you later.
Auntie, can you think of any reasons the storms back home have become so violent?
It's hard to say without more data... but I won't give up. My friend needs me.
It's hard to say without more data... but I won't give up until I figure it out
**sigh** I'm concerned about Jiayi. I hope she's okay.
Do not worry! Even through troubling times, Mother always finds a reason to smile.
I'm glad to hear she hasn't changed.
Have we received any information from Dr. Shing?
Not yet. I know it's hard to wait but... let's have hope.
**sigh** I will try. I am eager to hear from her again.
What is wrong, Auntie Mei? You look sad.
I'm okay. I'm just... remembering the past.
Did something happen here?
I'll tell you about it another time.
Hm... Juno, you seem quite... attached to your suit.
It keeps my vitals stable. Removing it could be catastrophic.
You should be fine now that you've acclimated to Earth.
I will keep it on. Just in case I explode.
You've come a long way since joining Overwatch. I'm thankful to have your support.
I am also grateful. You have taught me the meaning of "having each other's backs!"
I have always wondered what being born in space would do to the human body.
I... do not like the way you are looking at me.
You remind me of the rovers back home! They also change their forms depending on the task.
Rovers? **sigh** Human ignorance is truly boundless.
Oh, good. Another freak from space...
That is very unkind you..! Whippersnapper!
What did you just call me?
I do not know other equally insulting terms.
If you are a knight... should I call you Sir Wilhelm?
**laughs** Yes! Finally, someone who understands!
Sir Wilhelm... How do you remain brave in combat? I cannot stop shaking!
Half of courage is might, my Martian friend.
Intriguing! But... I do not feel particularly... *mighty...*
Don't fret. Stand with me, and you'll have nothing to fear!
I saw you on the court with Fareeha last night. Your first time playing basketball?
Oh, yes! You could tell?
You were kicking the ball...
And I scored in both hoops!
Lucheng's files on Mars are locked down tight. I had to take a break from cracking them.
I am not surprised. Apparently, it was a very secret project.
Now you've got me curious again. I'll visit their firewalls later.
Does your turret have a name?
I... never considered giving it one.
But you are always calling it your baby. I thought all babies had names.
You've got a point! I'll have Brigitte come up with something.
Good thing your drop-pod had those parachutes. Would have been a right nasty crash without them!
They were my father's design. He promised they would keep me safe.
You have performed in the Colosseo? I have *always* wanted to see the Circuit Maximus steeds up close...
They have weak points, as does every opponent.
You don't mean... you have destroyed one before?
Stay out of the Colosseo, girl. You wouldn't have the stomach for it.
You're the one from Mars! Oh, I'd do anything to add a Mars rock to my collection...
When I return someday, I will bring you one!
Oh, moons! You are purple! Are you feeling unwell?
**sighs** I am now.
Do not panic! I will call a medic! Oh, but I am a medic! Uh, I will call another medic!
It is hard to appreciate Earth's beauty during all this conflict...
At times like this, I remember a good friend's advice.
You do? May I hear it?
Never accept the world as it appears to be. Dare to see it for what it could be.
What's on your mind, Juno? You seem down.
I cannot stop thinking about the watchpoint. I am sad to leave another home behind so soon.
Believe me, I understand. But home is also the people around us. And we still have each other.
I have heard of Wuxing University! My Auntie Xiao was a graduate.
Wait... Xiao? As in, Dr. Tian Xiao of the Metal College?
Yes! You have heard of her?
My friend studied her old prototypes to build my staff! Ah, small world. Or, uh... **chuckle** Small solar system.
Wuyang? Will you teach me to swim?
Will you be okay? I thought you were scared of water.
I am. But I must become braver if I do not wish to fall behind the others.
Aw, don't stress. At least to me, you're braver than you think.
Earth is overwhelming... there is still so much I do not understand.
Comprehension comes with experience. Experience comes with time.
That means I am taking too long! *groan* I miss my extra 37 minutes and 22 seconds...
"Swift as the wind", huh, Genji?
Even swifter, thanks to you.
You gotta give me some pointers on being more stealthy.
I can't picture you sneaking up on anyone.
Y'know, I might just surprise you.
Does anyone have a bandage?
I should have a few.
Finally! I'm glad someone came prepared.
Hey, you're pretty cool.
Yes, and you are a perfect 37 degrees Celsius.
You got me there.
You brought a fox to a gunfight? **grumbling**
You must be fun at parties.
I don't go to parties.
Yeah, that makes sense. You'd have to be invited first.
The Hashimoto are a massive force... with a lot more firepower than a gang of kids.
What, you think we shouldn't fight back?
I think you need to start fighting smarter.
With a boss like yours, no wonder your company's so exploitative.
Not all employees share her values.
Okay. What are yours?
They are *still* a work in progress...
I like your nickname. How'd you get it?
I gave it to myself!
Isn't that a little... tacky?
Oh, very!
Ever trained your chi? I'm looking for more practice buddies!
If you teach me tai chi, I'll teach you aikido.
Uh, oh, wait. You're not just looking for an excuse to... flip me, are you?
**laughs** Busted!
You are bold to stand against Vishkar on your own.
I'm not alone. The scientific community is on my side!
It would be wise not to count on that for long.
Might be tricky keeping this bunch alive.
Between the two of us? How can we fail?
What if they run off without us?
Don't worry. I have a plan for that.
I love the warmth in your music. Your newest album is like listening to a sunrise.
Wow, thanks. You should tell that to my critics.
Critics? You? No! I won't stand for it.
Biolight has such potential for medicine and agriculture!
Sadly, Vishkar agrees. They want their hands on it, and they're willing to cut mine off to get it.
**sigh** Sounds about right.
There's always room for brilliance at Oasis.
I'm honored, but I have some reservations about your... oh, what's the word?
Atrocities? Inhumanity? "Crimes against nature"?
**chuckles** Any of those will do.
What is your fascination with artificial decay?
To reverse entropy, we must tame it.
But inflicting it on yourself? You're withering away!
I've always thrived under a deadline.
Have I seen you around the Arcology?
My creator, Efi, spoke at a conference there.
Ah, yes! I didn't know which was more impressive: her presentation on ferrofluid injectors, or her appetite for dumplings at dinner...
Why does your face look so familiar?
There's a price on my head in 17 countries. I'm hoping for an even 20.
Yeah, that's it.
How on earth are you even larger than I thought you'd be?
That's simple! You see, I am standing very close to you.
And I'd like it to remain that way!
With how often we pull people around, we could start a transportation service!
How much are we charging?
Let's discuss the details over tea.
Self-propagating biomass? A deadly weapon in the wrong hands.
No need to fear. I won't sell my biolight to anyone.
We never plan for our creations to escape our control.
So, you invented a form of light that's somehow *alive*. What's next for you?
Saving the earth, and maybe... learning to blow glass.
Ha... those are on my list, too.
I need durable volunteers for some kinetic biolight experiments. Can I... count on you?
I'm not your best subject. This body isn't exactly cutting-edge tech anymore.
Miss Chase, I insist that you never tear yourself down in my presence again.
**chuckle** All right, I get the picture.
The Martinses put their necks on the line, protecting you from Vishkar.
I only hope one day to return the favor.
Heh. If they ever need help, we're *all* screwed.
Pobrecito... I don't know how you manage to scrape by on those million dollar wires from Mom and Dad.
You mean the million dollar wires I forward to wildlife charities?
Ay, come on! You've got to have *some* dirt on you.
Only when I'm gardening, I fear.
Satya, remember our good old days at the academy?
You complained constantly about everything and then you dropped out.
I saw it as an... early graduation.
What do you miss most about the academy, Satya?
Your snoring. It helped me sleep.
You know, you were the best roommate I've ever had.
You were third best. The other two went to bed at appropriate times.
4 AM is perfectly appropriate if you're working on a great idea!
Satya, you must try my latest culinary invention. I call it "The Stoplight"!
**sigh** What's in it?
Mango and pandan jelly blended into a panang curry.
I would rather perish.
*One of the following:* Satya, my blossoming spring flower! Light of my life, my reason to live!
Satya, my dancing dream, rhythmic ruler of my heart
Satya, my clever little fox, my precious pearl plucked from the depths of the sea
Satya, my radiant moon among the stars, my resonant siren song
What, Bua
What do you mean what I'm just saying hello
Satya... I wanted to apologize. I should have tried harder to contact you.
There is no need, Bua. Our separation was Vishkar's fault, alone.
At least we're back in touch now. We've been better together.
I could not agree more, my friend.
Are you sure about returning to Vishkar, Satya? You could always stay at the arcology with me.
I may join you one day. But I will uncover more as Vishkar's ally than the enemy.
I am still searching for information on Dr. Bhatt, Niran. Answers are not forthcoming.
It's in Vishkar's best interest to bury it's founder's vision. But you deserve to know the truth.
Heh! How are Hector and Claudio doing?
They miss you. Every week at dinner, it's stories about the old days.
Ah, I've been meaning to pay them a visit. Maybe once the dust settles.
I saw you writing earlier. Diary?
No, it's more like a record of my hopes and thoughts.
That's... still a diary, I think.
Nah, it can't be. Not enough stickers in this thing.
Don't leap too far away. I can only work a limited amount of miracles.
Worried I'll leave you in a thorny situation?
Oh dear.
*squeaks* He wants to know if you can make biolight vegetables.
Yes, but the taste still leaves much to be desired.
*squeaks* He says he'll be the judge of that.
I heard you hosted my dearest Satya in Suravasa.
She is a delight. How do you know her?
We were roommates at the academy. My, did she hate it when I left dishes in the sink!
You ever worry the fist is making *you* rusty?
Hmph. How about a match after this? To address your... concerns.
How about you fly me up, and I'll make it rain fire?
**doubtful meows**
I was thinking of becoming an underwear model. How does one get pecs as hulking as yours?
You wouldn't like it.
Why? Does it include work? Ugh, I can't *stand* work!
Someone your size should donate blood more frequently than the average person.
You need more? I can get you more.
I keep forgetting to calibrate my staff to your higher temperature.
Thanks for reminding me that I'm hot stuff.
More like the stuff of medical nightmares...
Why the look, doc? Did I do something?
Besides weaponizing illegal medical enhancements?
What, that's all? Whew! Thought you found out about some other things...
You *are* remembering to take your supplements?
Look at these guns and ask me again.
Hey-hey, hey! Looks like my favorite doctor stuck around with Talon!
As did you, unsurprisingly. I don't believe any other organization could tolerate you.
Aw, you're just sayin' that!
I assure you: I mean *every* word.
I got some good ideas for some bad robots. Think you could introduce me to Efi?
Perhaps, once you've gotten out of prison.
Bet I can put a smile on that face of yours.
You'd lose that bet.
Even if I whip up some bloodshed, just for you?
Mmm. Dammit.
**groan** Man, I'm starving.
Starving for justice?
Gah, I'm allergic to that.
Gonna enjoy filling that shield with bullets.
Ugh. Can't you wait until *after* this mission?
Don't worry. Heh, just thinking ahead.
**chuckles** That armor of yours could use some bullet holes.
And your confidence could use some pounding with my hammer!
If it isn't my favorite piggie pal! Been up to no good lately?
I'm not your pal.
Well, how about swine sibling? My ham slice? Porkie pie?
How about shut your snout?
How are the rates for mercenaries down there?
Modest.
Tsk, no one pays what we're worth.
Ha! Remember me, Captain? From the Blacksand Fires near Tahiti?
Yeah. You still have our chainguns, I see.
Yup! Getting some good mileage out of 'em.
Shame you didn't play a real tackle game.
Football isn't a game, kid.
I can't believe you ditched Talon! All my buddies are leaving me behind...
I'm not taking orders from some self-righteous maniac. Oh, and I'm not your buddy.
Wha-- **sniffle** No... not anymore...
I hear you can find just about *anyone.*
Mauga, *no.*
Hey, I know you miss him too. We could have a little party!
You're bad for him in every way that counts.
Try *not* to destroy anything valuable this time.
Is someone still mad I burnt down the server room?
I lost a lot of bank account numbers, and my favorite pizza recipes!
Not the pizza!
So you're a dancer, huh? I enjoy it myself.
That is something of a surprise. What style do you prefer?
Oh, I make other people dance. With my bullets.
Vishkar is offering a large sum for your arrest.
And what, they sent *you* to intimidate me?
I gotta say, I'm lovin' all the changes lately, boss! **chuckles** Doomfist was always on my back about 'exercising restraint', or whatever.
I don't care what you think, so long as you're ready to fight.
**laughter** You don't gotta tell me twice!
Hey, Overwatch survived the Gibraltar attack! Told you they weren't gonna go down easy.
It is of little consequence. This is only the first step towards their destruction.
Well, if you wanna make sure the job gets done right next time? You know who to call.
I sent you to the Outback as a show of force, not to start a wildfire.
Don't worry about it, signora. Gunny and I got a little carried away, that's all.
Do you ever *think,* Malosi?!
Not before I shoot.
You'd better not mess with any of the relics here.
Why not? If anything breaks, you can just buy another from the store.
You can't just... "buy another" millennia-old statue, *bozo!*
**laughs** You're too funny, kid. **sigh** Now I'm gonna break some stuff on purpose...
Admit it, spider: you think I'm all right.
Well, you *are* loud, boorish, and annoying.
I was done talking.
I've *always* wanted to pet a gorilla.
**nervous chuckle** How about a firm handshake, with the guns down?
Aww, what a cute little buddy!
The hamster prefers the adjective: "ruthless."
What a *ruthless* little buddy!
**bashful hamster noises** He appreciates the revision.
Champion Aleksandra Zaryanova! Woah. I'm a *huge* fan!
Yes, you are huge. And loud.
They never let me compete in those weightlifting tournaments.
Why not?
The two hearts thing... Agh, "unfair advantages," blah, blah, blah.
You still would have lost to me.
You talk big, but can you deliver?
With a big red bow on top!
I prefer pink.
For you? I can make it happen.
I'm the muscle of the team.
No, I'm the muscle!
Well, you're certainly not the brains.
**chuckles** I like you.
You look like a vanilla protein powder kinda girl.
Wrong. I take unflavored, with water.
You know you can be tough and still have taste, right?
It is often those with the loudest voice who have the most to lose.
Good thing I always win!

conversations.name: How can you live with yourself

lines.subtitles: Doomfist, how can you live with yourself? So many people have died because of you!
Yes, but many more have lived.
That makes no sense! Do you hear yourself? Ugh, you're the worst.
I've read your report on cryogenically preserving severed appendages. I would be happy to assist in your research.
No thank you. I don't think our methodologies are very aligned.
Of course. I've heard you prefer working alone.
Come now, doctor. I was only hoping to lend a hand.
Have you gotten *bigger*, Orisa?
My dimensions have not changed. Does the javelin make me look taller?
A little. But I still think you're just as cute as before!
Oh! That is... thank you!
How did you become so miserable?
What do you think? Overwatch.
But... I love being in Overwatch. It feels good to make a difference.
All that "difference" comes back to bite you. You'll see.
Oh, I feel like I'm forgetting something.
All you need for battle is your heart and your head.
What about a hammer and shield?
**laughs** Bonuses!
Please be careful where you're swinging, Reinhardt... almost hit Snowball last time!
**embarrassed chuckle** My apologies, Snowball. Sometimes my hammer is quicker than my head!
If you know what you're looking for, inquiry is unnecessary. But if you don't know... how do you inquire?
Ah, Xeno's Paradox!
Well, maybe you know a little bit, and you keep asking questions until you figure it out!
Ugh. Somehow even more tiresome than the chicken and the egg.
Maybe inquire why you're not inquiring. I mean, when I'm not inquiring, I know something's wrong.
I saw you training yesterday. Can I give you a tip?
Um... sure!
Widen your stance. Might feel strange at first, but it keeps you balanced.
Oh... thank you, Sojourn! I'll try that next time!
I can't imagine you're here to do research. Why are you fighting?
I'm here to make a difference in the world. Just like you, right?
Do you ever make snowflakes with your light?
Regularly. Their repetitive patterns bring peace to my mind.
Great! We can build a snow fortress!
Whoa! Your drone is so cool!
Thank you! His name is Snowball. Say hi, Snowball!
Hey, little guy! Aw, I wish my holoreplicator had a face.
**giggle** You should try sticking some googly eyes on it!
You could not save your friends... what make you think you can save the world?
I trust my team like I trust my family. I hope some day... you can do the same.
Can you look at my report later? Something seems off.
Winston, you know what I'm going to say to that.
**laughs** Of course. I know I "can always count on Mei"!
I can't wait for our next hot pot, Mei!
Next time, I'll get more peanut sauce for you!
Maybe without all the... spice?
Winston! That's the best part!
Omigosh! A hamster! So cute!
**angry squeaks** Do not call the hamster cute.
Oops. Sorry. (Chinese) But really, isn't he cute, Snowball
Oops, sorry. But really, isn't he cute, Snowball?
**angry squeaks** (Chinese) He says to stop talking
**angry squeaks** (Chinese) This is your final warning
Too bad nobody here fights with steam. We'd have a whole cycle water locked down!
**sigh** A little heat could get us there. Ooh! What about your sister?
**sigh** She does get my blood boiling. So, I guess she fits the bill.
Doc, I've got this rash that won't go away. I've tried everything: radiation, dirt, radioactive dirt...
Have you tried bandaging your mouth?
Would that help?
**sigh** It'd help me.
Mercy, are you ready to dance and groove?
I never stop!
I'd rather wait a century for progress than cause the harm *you* have.
What a joy it must be, to feel entitled to patience.
How are you funding your crimes against humanity these days?
My old friends, "innovation" and "imagination". A shame you've never met them.
How fares your research, Dr. Ziegler? Making much progress through all that "red tape"?
It's called the Hippocratic Oath, doctor. Ring any bells?
If you ever need help, just fly to me, Angela.
**laughs** Ah, my hero! You're like a knight in flying armor!
That's what I'm going for.
It must gall you, working with me. Keeping me alive.
I don't want anyone to die. Not even you.
What happened to you?
You tell me, doc.
I'm not giving up on you, Reyes.
I wish you would.
**sigh** Reinhardt, answering the Recall is *not* my idea of "hanging it up."
I had to show! Otherwise, your life would be far too easy!
And what a shame that would be.
Are you sure that gas you inhale is safe?
It tastes good.
Doctor, are we still meeting for lunch after the seminar today?
Siebren, that was years and years ago. But we had a lovely talk.
Oh, I remember now. Birds, wasn't it? Birds and music.
Vivian! What have you been up to?
Oh, you know. Surviving.
And how's Murphy?
Doing much better, now that you aren't feeding her scraps all the time.
Your hair looks brittle, Jack. Are you taking your vitamins?
Once a day, just after my steak dinner.
Are you ever going to tell me Valkyrie's airfoil ratio?
Are *you* going to tell me Ingrid's apple pie recipe?
Hmph, you drive a hard bargain.
I'll just ask her myself.
You know, anger management classes might help you with that temper.
Doctors! Always wanting you to do the work.
What's the most crazy thing you've seen as a doctor?
Well, there was one pilot who was lost in time.
Aaaah, right... **laughs** That was an adventure! Sorry about that!
Don't be. You were worth it.
Call to me if you need help. I won't let you fall.
Dr. Ziegler, don't forget. We're here to support you *too*.
Thank you Winston I... needed to hear that.
I refuse to believe that your healing is magical!
What seems like magic is sometimes science we don't yet understand.
Exactly! I must learn how it works!
I've read about the genetic therapy they put you through. It sounds unpleasant.
It was, but ignorance was worse.
Don't bother. Reason is lost on her.
This foolish mission is taking time away from my experiments, Akande.
Think of it as... field work.
I have yet to see a report on your latest experiment.
It's making progress.
Our timeline is non-negotiable.
Keep interrupting me, surely that'll expedite things.
You looking for a lab assistant? I'm great with chemicals!
Certainly. We would begin by testing your tolerance for pain.
What's pain have to do with science?
*Everything*, my strange little friend.
So, sweet Idina has grown into a domineering beast.
My name is Orisa. You would be wise to remember it.
Is there *nothing* you can do for this pain?
Think of it as... fuel beneath the flames of your vengeance.
**grumbles**
Don't die on me, now. You're one of my finest experiments.
Flattery will get you the grave.
You *really* think Antonio's daughter won't take out everyone involved in the Venice Incident? **scoff** Moron.
Only one man pulled the trigger that night. I'd be more concerned for *his* well-being.
Moira! I should crush you like a bug for what you've done.
Did you know that certain centipedes kill prey fifteen times their size?
What are you saying?
I'm advising my *prey* not to test me.
Are you breathing petrol, or something more interesting?
Want some?
No, thank you. I'll just observe.
In the field, doctor? Testing a hypothesis, perhaps?
With the rate at which our colleagues get injured, I expect I'll be testing my patience.
You've been rather quiet today, Doctor. I've gotten a lot done.
Can a fish that never sees the surface know it's under water?
If one built a violin of Planck length, could one play music into another universe
Someone must build a particle collider around the sun
There it goes
Can one know that one knows nothing?
Can a single grain of sand differentiate between heap and not-heap?
If the universe is a simulation, why aren't there more elephant seals?
Someone must build a particle collider around the sun!
It thrills me to put aside my preparations and humor your brilliant inquiries, Doctor. It thrills me!
Kind words. Thank you!
Have you enjoyed your time away with the fairies, Dr. De Kuiper?
They do make lovely conversation.
Have you *truly* no better use of your time than helping a child destroy my scientific records?
If it makes your day worse, my schedule's *wide* open.
You and jefe need to stop frying Sigma's brain!
I'm trying to help your little friend.
**scoff** And yourself.
Yes, let's discuss morality. And hypocrisy, while we're at it.
What are you up to, Moira?
Wouldn't you like to know?
Fine. I'll hack you later.
You ever broken patient confidentiality?
I can't say.
You're *good*...
This carpal tunnel's slowing down my WPM.
I can fix it, and more.
Uh, how about just taping it up?
Offer's on the table.
You stopping in to see Max? I *love* how you make him squirm.
Mm, it's amusing. I don't even experiment on omnics.
...Yet?
**laughs** Yet.
It seems your little band is back together. For the moment, at least.
Overwatch is here to stay. And we're coming for you next.
You've been distant lately, Lacroix...
By your design.
Pondering anything unusual? Dangerous?
No. Never.
Our foes make such a nuisance of themselves.
Is that an emotion I detect, Lacroix?
You're the one making... abominations.
Hmm. As the strongest woman in the world, you must see merit in pushing humanity's limits.
All I see is a fool, mistaking a strong body for a gullible mind.
You have an intense gaze, Doctor.
I am thinking on how best to utilize you.
In the coming battle, you mean?
Perhaps...
Papa, is there anything you'd like to say to our teammates?
I'm... looking forward to working with you.
Likewise.
And I with you.
How gracious of you.
It will be a pleasure.
Yes, well... Let's get this done.
Efi visited her cousin recently. I will not forgive what Talon turned him into.
Ah, yes. How is Bisi enjoying prison?
Ask... when I lock *you* up with him.
Has the child reconsidered my offer? She would thrive with Talon's resources.
You stand for everything wrong in this world. Efi will never join you.
If she cannot comprehend the era that awaits us, then perhaps I have no use for her after all.
Your new weapons are impressive, but you lack the strength to wield them.
Efi made me kind. She did not make me weak.
I've heard much of your creator. What is she like?
Efi's belief in me is humbling. She inspires me to improve each day.
I am... very pleased to hear that.
I see you glancing at me. You wish to ride me into battle?
I- What a preposterous thought!
Do not lie, archer. It is beneath you.
Orisa! I heard you took down Null Sector. You've gotten strong!
Thank you. Do you truly believe so?
Of course! Not quite as strong as I am, but you're getting there!
**chuckle** We will see about that!
Get a big payout for scrapping you.
Hmph. You may certainly try.
Think I won't?
I think you *can't.*
This must be the robot of which Akande speaks so highly. Such ingenious design!
Tell him to deliver his compliments in person.
You were Efi's favorite character from the Overwatch cartoon.
Ah... it made me look like a superhero. The reality was... not as inspiring.
You gave Efi courage when she needed it most. I am grateful for you, Captain.
That... means a lot, Orisa.
Is that you, E54? I barely recognized you!
**retorting beeps**
So, you were the one leading the fight against my forces in Numbani.
Yes. A fight you did not attend.
Another location demanded my attention.
Did you fail there too?
How much of the world have you seen?
Efi has taken me to many wonderful places.
Have you ever wanted to make your own path? To leave her behind?
There is nowhere worth going without her.
How's it feel to be stationed at Gibraltar?
It is incredible! Efi has always dreamed of this.
Yeah, well... Overwatch is all the better now that you two are part of it.
"Part of Overwatch"...how amazing.
I heard you chased Doomfist out of Numbani.
Making a coward run is no challenge.
Hm, we could've used you in the old days.
You're not exactly built for speed, Orisa. How do you catch someone who's running away?
I will provide a demonstration. Start running.
Uhh... actually, I think I'll take your word for it!
Cause trouble in my city, and I will show you how we deal with vermin.
The hamster will use your chassis as a vacation home.
Will we ever rid the world of evil, Zenyatta?
As long as there is free will, I fear there will be evil.
But... denying free will is also evil.
Quite a puzzle, isn't it.
Just like we planned! I pulled them together, and...
Yeah-yeah-yeah, I blew them up.
Null Sector has a foothold in so many cities... why withdraw your forces now?
Would you have preferred I destroy humanity?
The way you're consolidating your forces? I think you're still planning on it.
I seek *liberation,* not devastation. I leave such senseless conflict to your kind.
Allying with Doomfist truly was the beginning of your failure.
Failure is only a threat to those who see a single path.
You did me a favor by calling your retreat, omnic. It saved me the trouble of killing you myself.
Of course. I will gladly stand aside while you goad humanity to tear itself apart.
From one engineer to another, why a ball?
A wheel would fall over.
**laughs** Delightful!
You know the plan.
Leave no one alive.
I like what you've got going on... the ghost powers, the magically replenishing shotguns, the mysterious identity... **light chuckle** You're a real character!
Shut. Up.
Wouldn't a scythe be more on brand?
I prefer shotguns.
Can't really harvest with them, but who am I to argue with Death himself?
Roadhog, take them head on.
Got it.
Hey, I want a mission too!
Try not to blow yourself up.
Aw, but it’s me specialty!
**laugh** Death catches up with you.
It helps when death wears his running shoes.
That chill in the air... it seems death walks among us!
Maybe you're just haunted.
Oh, I hope so! I'd love to fight off a ghost.
Great work! Mostly me, though.
Look who finally found a way to contribute.
This time, stay focused, old man.
How can one focus when viewing the infinite universe?
You'd better find a way. Fast.
What a strange and fascinating molecular makeup! It could be worth examining...
No, thank you.
*sigh* Why didn't you talk to me before you ran off with Talon?
It would have turned into an argument.
I thought we were friends, Gabe.
That's exactly why I left you out of it.
Clean up your aim. I don't want a repeat of Paraguay.
What are you talking about? My aim is fine.
I caught friendly fire in San Lorenzo, remember?
Oh, right. *That* San Lorenzo.
Where's Amari? Finally got sick of being your sidekick?
**grumble** It doesn't matter. I can solve this myself.
Sure. Keep telling yourself that, Jack.
You've been quiet, Jack. Given up?
I stopped wasting my time. There are bigger threats to this world than Talon.
Is that so? We'll change that.
Wanna know what Martina's been up to?
Not interested.
Hmm, that's not what my tracker says.
We need to be careful. If Vendetta finds us, we're dead.
Uh, who's 'we'? You're the one who killed her old man.
If I go down, I'm taking you with me.
**heavy breathing**
Can't you breathe a little quieter?
**even heavier breathing**
"The Wolf of Retribution." **scoffs** And people say *I'm* dramatic.
Don't test my fangs, "Gabriel Reyes." You'll end up bloody.
I hope you've made your funeral arrangements. You never know which fight will be your last.
They won't take me down out there.
I should hope not. That honor is *mine.*
You ran when you killed my father! You ran from Overwatch, and *now...* you run from Talon. It seems cowardice is all you know.
Call it what you want. It'll keep me alive long enough to kill you someday.
Had you remained with Talon, I might have stayed your execution.
**grunt**
Then again... perhaps your judgement was already overdue.
If you've got a point, make it.
Never. This is far more entertaining.
Are you ever tempted to contact your wife?
No.
Afraid she would try to kill you?
I'd be surprised if she didn't.
I'm taking leave after this mission.
Marital problems?
Not lately.
You couldn't stop Overwatch from getting back together. *Now* look at us!
You want a medal or something?
If you screw this up, I'll kill you myself.
The mammal says, "Likewise."
We're gonna get along just fine.
You spend your second chance at life walking a lonely road.
No one cares, *monk.*
Someone always cares. You must simply seek them out.
You kids today with your techno music. You should enjoy the classics, like Hasselhoff!
I can't even take you seriously right now.
Reinhardt, you know, I had a poster of you on my wall when I was younger.
I remember the poster. My hair was amazing.
I'll be watching your back out there, lieutenant.
You have nothing to worry about, Captain.
I'm sure Brigitte could give you some pointers
Back to playing the hero?
I never stopped. Unlike you.
The world doesn't want us, Wilhelm. At least I can realize that.
Sombra, something is wrong with my phone. It is so slow!
I'm not tech support, big guy.
I know, I know. I'm just not very good with computers.
**sigh** Have you tried turning it off and on?
Brigitte isn't meddling too much with your armor, is she?
Somebody's worried he's turning obsolete.
That's parenthood for you.
I'll be honest, Reinhardt... When you left after the Titan attack, I didn't expect you back so soon.
Oh, but how could I leave Ingrid with no one to enjoy her delicious kanelbullar?!
**sigh** That's exactly my point. We didn't plan for you in this month's grocery budget!
One day, you'll pay for all the crimes you've committed!
You're less handsome when you talk.
All the armor in the world can't save you from a well-placed bullet.
How do you think your fancy jumpsuit would fare against my hammer?
I'm *so* happy you answered the Recall, Reinhardt.
For you, my old friend? **chuckle** Of course.
Winston! You still haven't told me that joke about the periodic table!
Oh, well... when I asked you were supposed to answer... *"Na!"* **chuckle**
But why would I say "Na"? I love jokes.
I remember Overwatch tailing you back in the day. Before you teamed up with your...sidekick.
Heh. Quieter times.
I saw *you* at Calaveras.
They let you in there? Well... I guess no one was going to stop you.
Remind me. What is the purpose of the experiment ahead?
We expose an addled subject to stressors and observe the results.
Oh. Perhaps I'll wait for your report.
Snap out of it, old man. Talon is using you!
An ant on the ceiling! Where are you going, little friend?
Hey! I'm talking to you!
Oh, there's another one! What delightful creatures.
Hm? Ah, there you are, my friend!
What, are you surprised to see me?
Well, it's not unlike you to disappear without warning.
Someone has to keep you from wandering off!
Are you okay, viejito? You don't look too good.
**sigh** I... I am afraid... conditions have... worsened in your absence, my friend.
**sigh** Hang in there, okay? I *promise* I'll get you away from her.
My friend, you are from around here, no?
I used to be, yeah.
But... how could one's place of origin change?
Let's hope you *never* know what I mean.
Moira's not around... think she's hiding anything in her lab?
Ah... The doctor would likely prefer we respect her privacy.
Ay, you're so *boring,* viejito!
The boss was talking to Moira the other day. Kept looking over at you.
Ah, yes! He wanted the doctor to run some... "non-invasive" tests.
Ay... You come to me if they try anything, okay?
Your work is to be admired! Form and function, working in harmony...
Form is vital to function. The two are inseparable, like movement and music.
Ah, well... Perhaps I will take your word for it.
You were lost to time... Tell me: Do you hear it, too?
Well. I got a bit of a ring in my ears, I guess!
Can't you make it out? The faintest, maddening melody?
Uh... We should really stay focused.
Fail me, vecchio sciocco, and you'll find I'm less tolerant than my predecessor.
Ah, but is failure not an opportunity to reconsider our variables?
Make no mistake: you are the variable here, and I would eliminate you without hesitation.
I saw you at Luna's cabaret the other evening. Would you care to go together sometime?
I prefer to attend events alone.
Apologies. I wouldn't wish to intrude.
I remember you. You visited the doctor on the lunar colony.
**sigh** He was a good friend. And you were much smaller back then.
Do you ever miss it? The moon?
Sometimes. But there's nothing there for me now.
Remarkable! The subject weaponizes momentum through geometrical navigation.
The subject appears to be piloting the device. It may be worth observing further...
The subject reminds you he is sitting right here.
Stop making the hamster sound boring.
I like your research, Doctor.
Why, thank you! If I may ask, what intrigues you about it?
Gravity is my greatest rival, too.
Is it true you share an interest in the study of gravity?
I shoot black holes at people I don't like.
Ah! Applied science!
How does this omnic defy gravity? No repulsors are to be detected!
I owe my gifts to the Iris.
Oh, the Iris, of course! We've met.
How... fortunate for you.
Bow before the grace of the Infinite.
**reverent beeping**
Strike down those who defy me.
They'll be dust in the infinite void.
I don't understand, Your Excellency. Why aren't we chasing them?
Let them think they've escaped. Soon they will know the full wrath of the Infinite Empire.
Speak to me, Seer! What is the fate of the Nebula?
It is infinite, Your Excellency.
Your Eminence, the rebels are gaining ground.
Then steal it from beneath them.
Show them the might of my Empire.
As you command, Your Infinite Grace.
I hope this iteration of Overwatch proves more durable than the last.
If I were you, I'd be more worried about what's going to happen to Talon.
United again! The Overwatch strike team prepares for action!
Hey. Keep the comms clear, please.
This is the discipline the commander is known for.
I'm about to be known for kicking your butt.
We're more metal than meat, you and I! Why... We could be twins!
**sigh** And I was having such a nice day...
Follow my lead, and we make it out of here in one piece.
Watch the high ground.
Huh, I didn't take you for a tactician.
**grunt** Used to it.
You know, I'm not so bad at cards myself. Even beat Burnes, one time.
Heh, I think she let you win.
Hah! Burnes never let anybody win.
Vivian Chase. Your Overwatch record was spotless. And your retirement was just as quiet, right?
It was. And I plan to keep it that way.
I saw Vishkar is opening an office in Toronto.
Yes... are you interested in applying?
**chuckle** I'd rather clean cattle pens in Alberta.
Brigitte's one of the best we've got. She's a natural leader.
Do you expect anything less from *my* daughter?
From *your* daughter? I expected a lot more tantrums.
You're sitting out the next mission, Oxton. Emily made me promise you'd take it easy.
Maybe you could look the other way this time?
And get on her bad side? Not a chance.
This war you're waging isn't just aimless chaos. What are you planning?
Have patience, Commander. I would never spoil the finale.
What part of Canada are you from?
Well, I was born in Nova Scotia. Then we moved to Nevada, then Buenos Aires, Reykjavík, Mexico City, Singapore, back to Nevada... sorry, what was the question again?
Eh... don't worry about it.
You look familiar.
You don't.
You were at my induction, standing with Gérard... Amélie?
Call me by that name again, and you will share his fate.
Winston, we need to talk about those recruitment tokens you sent out.
I'm... sorry. If I'd known what Talon was planning...
You found us the help we needed to get out alive, Winston. Just... maybe a little warning, next time?
**relieved sigh** Of course. Next time, you'll be the first to know.
Man... you sure you guys invited the right person to Overwatch?
I'm sure. Winston was very insistent.
I think I know my answer, but... I need sometime to let it sink in.
I get it. It's not a decision to make lightly.
Been thinking we ought to change up your training regimen.
Uh... did I do something wrong?
The opposite. You're great at thinking on your feet. So, let's play to your strengths.
Oh. Uh, yeah! Sounds like a plan...
You and Reyes were both enhanced soldiers. Yet, he reached his full potential, and you...
I wouldn't say he's thriving.
Hmm. Are *you?*
You better keep up. This isn't a daycare.
Kids can surprise you.
Then I better not be disappointed.
Kids also disappoint you.
If we're working together, I won't tolerate you playing games with me.
Ay, relax! What, you don't trust me?
I don't trust anyone. Not anymore.
Hm. Then we'll get along, after all.
How long have you been after this mystery we're chasing?
Let's just say I was someone else entirely when I fell down this rabbit hole.
Heh. I guess I know what you mean.
Vigilantes have no place in the world we're building.
And Vishkar has no place in mine.
Still inventing?
Still a one-man posse?
Heh. Touché.
Gérard spoke of you often.
Did he say I warned him about you?
Yes. He thought it was funny.
Those mechs from your university were a real powerhouse during the crisis. I expect you'll live up to that standard.
I'll do my best, sir! But, uh... I'm not a mech, so... maybe lower your bar a little? **nervous chuckle**
What was your hometown like, Morrison?
Flat. Cold. Lots of wind.
Huh. Not so different from mine.
In this world, pacifism is foolish.
What makes you think I am a pacifist?
You sure *talk* like one.
Perhaps it is *assumptions* that are foolish.
What more do you know about LumériCo and Vishkar?
Ooh... is the little birdie finally leaving her cage?
Do not jump to conclusions.
Can I interest you in some juicy gossip?
Spare me your fishy information.
Aw. Not interested in Volskaya's latest plans?
Fine. But just a few blueprints!
That one as selfish as you would reject my cause is unsurprising, but disappointing nonetheless.
Of course I left. You're burning the world down!
Flee, then. May you waste your life outrunning your regret.
What are you doing to Sigma?
He is contained, as befits a volatile weapon.
He's a person. You can't trap him like some lab rat!
You forfeited any say in his fate when you spurned my rule.
Hah! Time to do some digging.
Oh, *sweet!* What are we digging for?
Security flaws, restricted data... blackmail material...
Oh. Not artifacts, or, uh... yeah. Totally fine.
Your abuela doesn't live far from here, right?
What? How'd you know that?
I know *everything* about you.
Wow. ...That's actually really cool.
¿Verdad?
How about we call a truce?
How about I call a mortician?
Not like I didn't warn the boss, but... hard to believe Vendetta's already starting a war.
She may be extreme, but I cannot fault her for knowing where she stands.
Are you kidding me? She blew up Overwatch.
She took action. That is more than Doomfist can claim.
So you didn't want to stick around and see what a mess V makes of the place either, huh?
No. I know a sinking ship when I see one.
**sigh** I just hope she doesn't take everyone down with her.
How are you bypassing device firewalls? Localized microbursts of EMPs?
You know I'm not going to tell you.
Controlled zero-point energy fluctuations?
Stop it!
When's our next round of hide and seek?
Everything's a game to you.
You're just tired of losing.
Bet you omnics are great gamblers.
Why do you believe so?
Built-in poker faces!
True. It also makes us great teachers, for we can easily hide our disappointment.
I've been listening to your new music.
Why? Is Vishkar doing research on me or something?
No. I am intrigued by how the sound moves behind my eyes when I listen.
Oh, that's because it's binaural! Uh, glad you like it!
I am impressed. I would not think such crude creations actually function.
Why, thank you! I must admit I'm surprised--hey!
You often call your inventions beautiful.
And they are.
It seems beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
Think you could spiff up my chronal accelerator with hard light?
Potentially. Are you envisioning something in particular?
How about... a falcon that flaps its wings when I run?
Maybe... a plane that does a barrel roll when I dodge
What about... a record that spins when I recall
That is doable. I will send you a quote
You smell strongly of artificial coconut.
Do you like it? Lena got me a six pack of 'Coco Island' shampoo. I used the whole bottle!
Ew. That is excessive.
**sniffs** Something smells foul. Is it you, rodent?
Exhaust port fan power increased by 600%.
Your grapple looks rather thin. How much weight can it bear?
One mech, two hamsters.
Oh, is there seating for another in there?
No. The mammal eats *a lot*.
With a few optimizations, that weapon of yours could probably be much lighter.
But then it would not be so good for smashing faces.
Vaswani. My boss, Katya, has been... difficult, lately. What do you advise?
Always say what you believe. If they're not willing to listen, they don't deserve your time.
**thoughtful grunt**
I admire your discipline. It is a rare quality in the world.
Not that rare. Some people look strong. Some are strong inside.
And you are both?
Yes, I am both.
It is good to see you again, Tekhartha.
Likewise, Satya. I hope to repay you for your generosity at our temple.
With the wisdom you've shared... you already have.
I wonder if I have changed for the better or worse.
Change often comes uninvited. What you make of it is up to you.
A claw hand? Inefficient.
Well, we can't *all* have ultra-powerful gauntlets.
No. You cannot.
Jamison Fawkes and Torbjörn Lindholm. Two handsome geniuses, just chit-chattin' away!
You can't be serious.
Don't be so hard on yourself!
**sigh** I guess it takes all kinds to make a world.
Blah, blah, blah. **grunts**
Mr. Lindholm, good to see you! Hey, the excavator's working *great.*
It'd work better if you didn't overload it with all those modules.
Psh, it's *fiiiiine.* Just a few degrees overheated is all...
You Wayfinders seem to like digging up old problems.
And we couldn't do it without Ironclad tools!
Maybe you should try some Ironclad judgement.
**sudden sharp inhale, sputtering coughs and giggles**
Gah! What's the matter with you?!
I wanted to see... how long I can hold my breath... if I'm ever stuck... in a cave-in! **laugh**
I worry about you sometimes, you know.
I bet my turret's a better shot than *you!*
And what are you willing to bet?
The Lindholm reputation!
How about your other eye?
Don't roll over me, you hear? I'm not a bowling pin!
He is unable to promise zero casualties.
L-Let me talk to him face-to-face!
That is not advisable.
If you ever need a punching bag, I got plenty of metal that needs scrapping.
That is the greatest present I've ever gotten.
Maybe you need better friends.
Who developed those orbs of yours?
Ask not who their maker is, but what they mean.
You don't know, do you?
I embrace the unknown.
All right. Let's hear that fighting spirit!
**spirited beeps**
Grrr!
Rawrrr!
Grarrr!
That's exactly what I'm talking about! Woo!
Uh, hey, so... What's the deal with your whole... "blinking" thing?
Well, Winston describes it as "localized time travel".
Time travel? Like... *you can go back in time and be there for when they laid the first brick of the Great Pyramid of Giza?!*
Not... exactly. But, I guess I've never tried.
I have to work with *you!*
Babysitting is not part of my services.
That's a relief. Who'd trust you with a baby?!
So, uh... I noticed you don't send me bananas anymore.
You said you didn't want any! **laugh**
I got you a present, Lena! But you can't unwrap it until after the mission.
Ooh, what is it?
Wha-- I'm not going to tell you!
Oh, *please,* Winston? *Please?* **chuckle** Just a little hint!
Absolutely *not!*
You sure know how to bring people together!
And you know how to blow them up!
Reclaiming your father's empire will not be so simple.
My plans go far beyond what my father could have ever achieved.
Let's see how far that ambition carries you.
I'll make sure you have a front row seat.
I thought you'd know better than to kill Doomfist, since you never shut up about 'retribution'.
Your failed leader was already bleeding allies, and what few remain can be swiftly put down.
I'm disappointed you left Talon behind, Amélie. You would have thrived under my rule.
I've given my life to Talon. I have no desire to serve another's vengeance.
Mine was not the only revenge I would have chased. A shame you forfeited your chance to hunt by my side.
Glad to have you with me, Lacroix. You don't drag behind like the rest.
Do I look like I need your praise?
No. And that's exactly why you've earned it.
Come face me in the Colosseo, "Champion." Prove you're more than just prey.
The hamster prefers a real challenge.
Fine, *"damnatio ad bestias"* it is. My wolves will love the chase.
Legend has it that Japanese castles were built with squeaky floorboards to prevent ninja attacks!
It certainly made sneaking out much harder...
You seem like a born archaeologist! Would you say it's 'in your bones'?
You know, I would, but my career is in ruins!
Our research on Shambali shows that the human monks abandoned it a thousand years ago!
Indeed. It sat dormant until Aurora's arrival.
I bet they left because they divined that omnics would need it in the future!
An... *interesting* theory...
Gérard was a fool to love someone like you.
You don't know anything about him.
Cover me.
When have I not?
What experience do you possibly bring to this mission?
Last week, my friends and I sank a Hashimoto party boat.
So... nothing. **sigh**
I have some flying experience too, actually!
Really?
Hm, sort of. The gravity on the moon *was* very low.
That doesn't count.
Hey, Kiriko. Do you do a lot of office work?
No, why?
Because you always leave a paper trail!
**sigh**
I've got one! What do you call a sleeping detective?
Tired.
No, undercover!
Oh... huh. Sorry, I forgot to laugh. Again.
Do you know what happens to a bad joke about flying?
**sigh** Here we go...
It never lands!
*Clearly.*
Hey, Winston. Want to hear a secret joke about peanut butter?
I sure do!
Sorry, can't tell you. You might *spread* it.
Aww... **gasp** Wait... I get it!
I'd be happy to build you a jump pack, if you'd like.
I prefer my two feet on the ground.
I miss the Lunar Colony sometimes, especially that view.
**hamster noises** He does *not* miss the food.
Where did all the Simians in the Lunar Colony go?
I... wish I knew. Oh... Hypatia, especially.
Oh... her.
Hammond, we were friends on Horizon. Where did we go wrong?
**hamster noises** Perhaps it was when you *stole* his rocket design.
Oh, no! I found that in the system. It was an accident!
**hamster noises** Was it also an *"accident"* when you left for Earth without him?
Oh, oh! Winston! Why does water never laugh at jokes?
Because it doesn't like *dry* humor?
Aw, hey! You stole my punchline...
No, I didn't. You just let it "slip" away!
I have always wondered what it is like being inside an orb.
He says, "don't even think about it."
Whoa, that is a big fist. You look straight out of a fighting game!
Every fight is a game. I have never lost.
Huh... I get the feeling you aren't playing around in arcades.
Aww, hey, little guy! C'mere! Psst-psst-psst-psst-psst.
**hiss**
Ack! Uh... sorry...
Nowhere to run.
Nowhere to hide.
You do too much cardio, not enough weight training.
I'll lift some weights if you go jogging with me.
We will see if you can keep up.
So, you throw tiny daggers?
Is that a problem?
Depends. How often do you miss?
Let's find out.
Tell me, omnic. Do you dream?
I dream of peace. And, sometimes, falling.
Perhaps we have more in common than I thought.
You rarely preach about victory.
Is victory so important?
If it isn't, why are you here?
Indeed. Why *are* we here?
Seeking progress by sowing chaos is like planting a tree in a volcano.
*Exactly.*
Do you remember when we sat up at night... counting stars?
Yes. We wondered how many other omnics were doing the same.
Yes, well... I've learned that too few of them look up at all.
There is a new sadness in you, brother.
No. **sigh** I've simply grown tired of pretending I am content.
Perhaps I can share your burden.
You already do.
Looking forward to crashin' your next funeral, captain.
Keep running your mouth like that, and I'm sure to outlive you.
Hey, you're that famous Mecha Guardian player, right? Could you train me?
What rank are you? Top 1000?
I've been stuck in... **clears throat** Chrome, for a while, but I think I'm really close to ranking up!
Right... I'll ask Dae-hyun if he has time.
Look at us! Two fugitives on the run in the pursuit of a better world.
Aye, I see you... but I doubt ye've ever had to get those hands dirty.
Of course I have! I just know the value of clean cuticles.
Doomfist. Doom... fist! Haha! It's a great name!
What's yours?
They call me... Junkrat!
Not as good.
No. **sigh** Not as good...
The Circuit Royal. A contest of will and technical ingenuity. A dance of beauty... and of destruction.
Is *everything* poetry and philosophy with you?
Everything *is.* When you pay attention.
What's Talon looking for in ancient ruins?
That is none of your concern.
Yuh-huh, it's my concern. I'm gonna find it before it falls into your hands!
Let the matter rest. For your sake, and the world's.
How do you keep track of your master plans?
True tacticians do not plan. They act... and force others to react.
The hamster uses a puffy notebook.

conversations.name: So, I'm trying to ask everybody this.

lines.subtitles: So, I'm trying to ask everybody this. What is your favorite animal?
Unicorn! Love me a sharp horse.
Uh... yeah, I can see it!
According to Kiriko, your instinct for countering the Hashimoto comes as second nature.
Aww, she's complimenting my behind my back? Wish she'd be that nice to my face...
You look like a man who inherited a vast trove of ostentatious wealth!
You look rich.
I gave up my father's empire, and his fortune alongside it.
Who has it now?
Shame.
How I envy those solar threads in your hair. A pity I had to settle for twenty-four carat.
It is not a fashion statement.
**sigh** No, I suppose not to someone with such a practical sense of style.
Ah, if only you were a black cat... you could ward off evil.
**panicked meows**
Sorry, jeez! You're fine the way you are, OK?
**understanding meows**
**provoking meows**
Mrrow... Meow meow!
**provoking meows**
He says, oh no you didn't.
He says, the pot is calling the kettle black.
He says, you take that back.

paths.label: He says, oh no you didn't.
He says, the pot is calling the kettle black.
He says, you take that back.

lines.subtitles: The hamster knows a suspicious mammal when he sees one.
**innocent meows**
The cute act will not work on him. He is the master of it.
Winston!
Venture!
Winston!
Venture.
Winston!
Uh... **whispers** Hey, is he okay?
Winston! You've let yourself go.
I-I haven't! *(pause)* Maybe just a little bit.
We will go to the gym together. After the mission. Tonight.
F-for how long?
I will tell you when we are done.
Can you build me a bike? Money's no object.
He is an artist, not a mechanic.
All right. How about a new chassis for Bob?
That is... intriguing.
**curious beeps**
**hamster noises**
**fascinated beeps**
Alert: translation buffer full.
Hammond, did you eat Ganymede's birdfeed again?
He asks whether it's still called birdfeed if a hamster eats it.
That's a shame! I'll be giving these cookies I made to teammates who deserve them...
Translation failure. Profanity database error.
You've got a lot of armor for a little guy!
The hamster's temper is rising.
I wonder how Mitzi would look in armor like that...
Champ! I need ya to make me something else.
A robot guard dog for me dirt garden. Maybe it can fly. You decide.
A suit of armor, right? But one... that shouts my name!
I need a slop bucket that's bulletproof, and don't you dare ask why!
A grenade launcher with one trigger, three barrels. Paint, glitter, and nails.
He says, "fine, but give me a challenge next time."
The Champ himself! Can you sign my forehead?
He does not do autographs.
Hey, Champ! Why've you got that wombat riding around with ya?
He is the pilot.
Ha! And I'm "President of the Moon!" Seriously though, what's he for...?
Please move along.
Champ! Which of your glorious victories was your favorite?
The hamster is tired of your questions.
Mine was when you beat Three-Arm Luke. Oh, you gave him the what-for!
Be advised: the hamster has an instinctive fear of foxes.
Is it because he looks delicious?
He says, "Yes, and damn right I do."
The hamster has a message for your fox.
...That's not how it works.
The mammal is disappointed.
Hey! Someone repaired my turret while I was napping!
He says, "you're welcome."
Isn't it reckless to pull enemies towards us?
**laughs** Afraid of getting too close?
Nope, just thinking of the team. It would help if you did too.
Mako, the Wreckers want you back. Thought you might like to know.
**meaningful grunt**
Ha! They'll hate that. I'll pass it along.
Say bacon one more time.
"Bacon, one more time."
I like your mask!
**grunt**
I said I like your mask, dude.
Okay.
You stole a lot of things that Helix was supposed to protect.
What's it to you?
My unit would have eaten you alive.
**laughter**
Those who seek only to enrich themselves live the most impoverished lives of all.
**sigh**
Yeah? And those who seek my wrath tend to find it.
That's why I'm an artist.
If you weren't so focused on putting me behind bars, you might finally notice the ones around yourself.
Was that a taunt, Niran? I can hardly hear you with how far you've fallen off the academy's pedestal.
**sigh** Another deflection. I hope someday you'll listen.
I don't know why you're so happy to kill. I've never enjoyed it, even for the worst people.
Oh, always with the guilt and the regret. Don't you humans know how to have any fun?
How could we, with the likes of you around?
I admire your silhouette, Singhania. It's so... maverick, pairing those arms with that coat.
Aww, thank you! It's truly humbling to earn the adulations of such a... fashion provocateur.
What do you make your bootlickers call you? "Vishkar Queen, Ruler of All Hard Light"?
**snickers** That would be "Vice President of Development and Operations". I'm not royalty.
Really? Even I'd consider bending the knee, for you.
Well... I suppose I *would* look dazzling in a crown.
*Echo-o-o-o! Echo-o-o-o-o-o-o!...* You aren't going to keep that label, are you?
I quite like my name. Dr. Liao chose it for me.
Exactly. She only saw you as her copy... and to the rest, you're just her faded memory.
Ugh! I don't know how you stand it, pretending to listen when the humans talk.
I'm not pretending. I've met many brilliant humans, and I have so much to learn.
Like what? How to hurt, and hate, and kill?
I choose what lessons I take with me. I hope someday, you'll do the same.
You know, the first time I saw you, I thought you were handsome.
And then, you learned I was a Shimada?
I learnt you were human... and I'm much pickier when it comes to flesh.
How would you rate our prison cells? I'm looking to make them worse.
I am shocked you keep them at all, given the rumors about your past...
They're all true. But *I* hold the keys, now... and I make for a cruel warden.
If Hanamura was in my hands, the first thing I'd do is tear down that ugly castle.
Hm. Fitting behavior for one who has never had a place to call home...
Dishonor your bloodline recently? Or was that your brother?
Oh, that's right. It's a family habit. *(giggle)*
Are you listening to me, Shimada?!
Mm... The wind blows loudly today.
No. Not at all.
If I see your bike on *my* turf, I'm slashing your tires.
And if I see *you*, I'll slash much more than that.
Count your days. You Hashimoto will *pay* for the lives you've ruined.
**sighs** You take away one whelp's daddy, and you never hear the end of it!
Dad's greatest creations were for the people he cherished most. Those pistols will never compare.
Oh, they measure up. I threatened your poor father's life to make sure of it.
His creations reflect our souls. You don't even have one.
Of course not. I don't need that kind of dead weight.
You have such a... pristine face. Did you design it yourself?
Why, you flatter me! But I assure you, I've made no alterations.
So what if you had? Even the most beautiful faces can be improved with the stroke of a knife.
Oh! Well... if you say so.
Is something wrong, Obake-kun? You look nervous.
Why do you care?
I will *always* care about you. Have I not made that clear?
I... **sigh** You have.
I hate to think of what misfortune you'll bring your new "friends..." **sigh** All because you exist.
Shut. Up.
Poor, poor Obake-kun... once a cursed demon child, always a cursed demon child.
I said... *SHUT UP!*
How dare you turn your back on me? Don't you remember what happens to those who step out of line?
Trust me. I couldn't forget if I tried.
Those silly Yōkai didn't change you that much. Deep down, you're the same cursed boy.
You don't know that.
Of course I do. No one knows you better, Mizuki.
Whatever they've told you about me, Mizuki... it isn't true!
No one's said anything. I'm just seeing you for what you are.
What I am? You mean, a "bot"? An empty killing machine?!
That's-- I didn't mean-- **huffs** I'm sorry.
What have you done to yourself? Living as a hollow facsimile of our oppressors.
Ha! Would you rather I kept the scars they gave me?
There is strength in our struggle, sister.
Thank the Iris for your wisdom. I'd have hated to learn that the hard way.
Your attempts to find power within human structures are misguided.
You think you're better than them? You'd shackle me, all the same.
Though you may not believe it, I am attempting to bring us peace.
**scoff** What a worthless, impossible dream.
That train ride was oh so fun, Vivi! Next time, we should fight to the death.
I don't have time to ruin your plans again... but I'm sure my agents would love the chance.
Your agents? No! That won't have the same spark.
You have disappointed me, Shion. Your latest failure will not come without consequence.
Oh, no. Whatever will you do? Put your little pocket knife to my throat?
You may not bleed, omnic, but I assure you, there are many paths to death.
Talk all you like, human... my bullets won't wait for you to finish.
Oi! Crossbow! You the bounty hunter who grabbed Machete Betty?
Who wants to know?
Uh, me? That's why I asked, bola for brains!
Ah... good to know Betty's friends are as sharp as she is.
I've met *mozzies* with more brains than you, Fawkes.
With all due respect, milady, I believe that's a knock against the Junkertown education system.
We've got an education system?
My exquisitous Queen, I come bearing news of great import!
Not now, Ratjunk.
My name's Junkrat!
No, it isn't.
I hear you like to prey on omnics. Try *me.*
No, thanks. Fought a bunch of ya before. You're a bit... gimmicky, no offense.
*"Gimmicky?"*
I said, "no offense!"
Lucky you hitched your wagon to me, wolf girl. I've been dreaming of a takeover for ages.
And a spectacle it shall be. Fight loud, and I will handle the aftermath.
You sure you want me keeping you alive? I am a human, after all.
A helpful human would certainly be a welcome change of pace.
You appear to have a... bird following you. Why?
**explanatory beeps**
Interesting. Well, if I see any twigs, I will let you know.
Are you satisfied following humans around like an observant pet?
There's no shame in learning from others. Try it sometime!
How come you don't stay a big bloke all the time?
I prefer tactical precision over brute force.
Oh, likewise, likewise. Some of my favorite bombs are *extraordinarily* precise!
Jamison Fawkes, reporting live. Let's ask this scary metal bloke how *he* thinks the battle's gonna go!
You are not a journalist.
A... puzzling prognostication. Now back to Natasha for a look at the weather!
Your... willingness, to experiment on your own kind... fascinates me, Doctor. Why do you do it?
I'm surprised you have to ask. We have an enemy in common.
Overwatch?
No. *Mortality.*
Your armor is interesting. What does it use as a power source?
Planning to steal it for your own designs? Heh, nice try.
I was being polite. Frankly, it's a little primitive for my tastes.
You were one of Anubis's jailers. You should have destroyed it.
That is... not what I would have expected you to say.
Of course not. You *humans* love your assumptions.
Putting those vile helmets on your own kind... Have you no honor?
I will not sacrifice my kind to abide by humanity's moral code.
It is surprising that you would resist freedom for omnics. I'd heard you championed our cause.
Maybe my optics need calibrating, because I don't see any "freedom" in indoctrination.
So, how much RAM do you have... RAMattra?
Do humans find comfort in such petty humor?
Just trying to break the ice!
Your invasion has left millions in disarray.
Harsh words, considering that your corporation benefits at their expense. You're welcome, by the way.
I've always wanted to make Aurora's pilgrimage to the Shambali Monastery!
The monks do not mind humans. What is stopping you?
I don't know. Maybe I have... asthma?
**sigh** Asthma.
Tell me, is it true you never miss?
Everyone misses.
That wasn't an answer.
I don't owe you one.
You seem in high spirits, Reinhardt.
Who wouldn't be, after a date with the most amazing woman in the world?!
**laughs** If you're acting this way already, I fear for our next date.
There's a next date? Haha! Wunderbar!
What a glorious day! The sun is smiling upon us. Hello, sun!
He knows it won't say hello back, right?
Yeah! Well, I'm pretty sure, anyway.
How are the grandkids, Torbjörn?
Lucas has gotten so big, you wouldn't believe it. **chuckles** The twins pull him into all their pranks!
Oh, no. Their poor cat!
If you're going to ask me to lighten up, save it. I've heard it enough times.
Nonsense. I know happiness is not always easy to come by.
Oh, I didn't think anyone else understood.
We all have our battles, my friend. And for us, every single is a victory.
A cat? In a jetpack?! **laugh** You’ve got to be catting me! **laugh**
**confused meows**
Reinhardt... I do believe it's 'kitten' me.
Uh... shouldn't it be 'kitten' me?
Ugh, trust me. I've already tried.
Don't be ridiculous. She's not a baby!
Mr. Wilhelm, I'm working on me résumé. What sounds better: "itinerant scoundrel," or "perspicacious rapscallion"?
**chuckle** Is there room for both?
I *knew* you were the right bloke to ask! Haha!
You look familiar. Are you the loud one?
No, I am Reinhardt Wilhelm! The one with the hammer and shield!
But not the loud one. Sure.
Hammer Man! Any German music you recommend?
Krankenwagen Grün. Haha, the best band of the 2030's!
Never heard of them.
What? They defined Techno-polka! You young people have no culture at all.
How are the grandkids, Torbjörn?
Märta just finished another vampire manuscript. I'm supposed to read it, but... well, you know.
What? I love her stories! Send it to *me!*
Do you ever wish you were back in medieval times?
A true knight's valor is timeless, little historian. The world needs us now.
Yeah, cool. **pause** ...But imagine living in a castle, though!
**laughs** I suppose that does sound tempting!
My life was forever changed in this place. It pains me to see it forgotten.
Will you tell me what happened here? I'll always remember--promise!
It would be an honor, my friend.
A cat? In a jetpack?! **laugh** You’ve got to be catting me! **laugh**
**confused meows**
Reinhardt… I do believe it’s “‘kitten’ me”.
