Don’t be ridiculous. She’s not a baby!
Ha! Magnificent electromagnetism!
You were pretty magnificent yourself, Doc.
Ha! Up top, Doctor!
Hm? Up where?
Too slow! Um... never mind...
Hm... why does this place feel familiar?
We've been here, viejito. This is where Max lives.
Ah, yes, Maximilien! His collection of Greek sculptures is quite charming.
I must say, Brigitte, you've really proven yourself. You have your father's smarts, Reinhardt's bravery.
Aw, thanks. But not the charging or yelling, right?
Not yet. You still have work to do.
In Egypt, cats were often seen as fierce protectors.
**questioning meows**
And yet you seem more likely to protect your kibble.
How's our base looking these days, sweetheart? You fix that Bob-shaped hole in the wall yet?
Why don't you swing by? See for yourself. We'll even throw you a little welcome party.
I'm sure it'll be a real barn burner.
I'll bring the fireworks.
You've been in the fight a long time. Ever consider a life beyond battle?
Sometimes, but I think any chance of that is long gone.
I used to think that, too, brother. But believe me, there's always another path to take.
Yeah. I'll keep that in mind.
You getting homesick, too? Huh. Guess we were never good at sticking anywhere too long.
Maybe not.
Well, wherever you wind up, if you ever need a gunslinger, you can always count on me.
And if you ever have a need of my blade, it is yours.
When exactly are you planning to come clean to the others that you're ex-Talon?
You may be forgetting that the last time someone found out, he tried to kill me.
That was me, but Vivian's got her head on straight. She'd understand.
I'll think about it.
The manner in which you have enhanced yourself with cybernetics is quite exciting.
I've always felt that my modifications are just an extension of myself.
Curious. I have felt that myself is an extension of my modifications.
Doesn't matter how many upgrades you get, Echo. You'll still be you.
You have been acting strangely since returning from Grand Mesa.
Yeah. An old friend I ran into. She uh gave me a lot to think about.
I see. Are you going to leave, Cassidy?
Let's save it for after this mission.
You've been off since Grand Mesa. Everything all right?
I don't know. I guess I didn't expect to see our old teammates.
I'm sure they'd take you back. You don't have to stick around with Talon.
I know. I know.
You really think you'll find answers working with Talon?
I don't know. But, it feels like my only option.
Then we'll see it through.
This serum from Grand Mesa, how's your boss planning to use it?
You're suddenly interested in what becomes of our bounties, are we?
No. Just staying informed.
Continue supplying my experiments, and the entire world will know the results soon enough.
Mizuki, you should have stopped climbing walls.
What? Why?
It is a valuable skill.
Ugh, what's wrong with you people?
I am glad you have chosen a side, brother. I have always been on yours
If only I had understood that sooner.
Backing the Hashimoto was a mistake. The sons of Shimada will not rest until Talon is cleared from our streets.
Good. The restless are careless and easy to put down.
It was reckless of you to take on the Hashimoto in that arcade. Be grateful Kiriko and I came to help.
From what I hear, she once helped you escape a similar predicament.
That was different.
I would never suggest otherwise.
**sigh** I wish I'd had control over my own fate that day...
Yeah, I've been there too.
Yeah, we've all been there.
Can you keep a secret?
**affirmative meow**
Sometimes I rehearse my conversations with Chuño before I have them for real.
You want a treat?
**enthusiastic meow**
Me too, if only someone would give us one.
**agreeing meow**
Hi. What is Perú like?
It's a beautiful place.
Yeah, yeah, but is it worth conquering?
If you don't mind getting blasted to pieces by the power of the sun.
Hunt any foxes recently?
Can't say that I have. All the ones I've seen recently are runts.
Guess you'll find other ways to turn a profit.
Watch it, sugar.
You make some impressive copies of Dad's animal avatars.
Thank you. That functionality should be near 99.99% accurate.
Not trying to beat the real thing, I hope.
I wouldn't dare.
If you're willing to share, how did you know that you were non-binary?
It was like, you know that feeling when you've been puzzling over a ruin for weeks and then you find that one clay urn that brings the whole story together?
I can't say I'm familiar.
Oh. Well, it's like that.
You should be careful making deals with Moira.
I assure you, she and I have an equal partnership. If you're trying to turn me against her, you won't succeed.
Perhaps, but you should know she's not so agreeable as she appears to be.
Do not assume my ignorance. I know her nature as well as my own.
You did the right thing leaving Vishkar behind. The rest of those drones ought to take notes.
Well, I'm sure it's not so simple for everyone.
Get real, man. You think walking away is harder than ruining people's lives?
At Vishkar? You'd be surprised.
I know of a procedure that could tame those emotions of yours.
Let me remind you what happened last time I had an operation.
That serum you retrieved is coming along nicely, Emre. You're rather useful when you care to show up.
Well, I'd hate to make your life too easy.
Our facility's data on the Inti Warriors was corrupted recently. Would you happen to know who'd do such a thing?
No, but whoever did it was keeping our secret safe from monsters like you.
No matter. Rest assured, I will work tirelessly to salvage what remains.
I always heard the gangs out west were small-time. Isn't working with Talon a little ambitious?
Come on now. Can't fault a girl for dreaming big, can you?
I can fault her for armed robbery.
Ugh, details.
I'll hand it to you. You've turned Talon into a real monster.
All the better to crush your pathetic resistance.
One thing you ought to know about Overwatch, we don't go down easy.
I am counting on it.
Give my thanks to your parents for letting us operate out of their home. And sorry for all the noise.
Oh, don't worry about that. Mama says it's the quietest the workshop has been in years.
You deployed to Tokyo against orders? Careless decisions like this got Overwatch shut down in the first place.
I have spent a lifetime running from my responsibilities. It is time I face them.
How are your experiments with the enhancement serum progressing?
Progress cannot be rushed. When I have the results, you'll be the first to know.
Time is of the essence, Moira.
Uh, new overseer, same impatience.
You've enjoyed Talon's protection long enough. Soon, you must declare your loyalty.
And what happens if I don't?
Then I will hunt you down myself.
You want to play my game? I thought you hated losing.
You stand no chance against the Hashimoto. If you so readily welcome their informant into your ranks.
The Yokai aren't an army, we're a family. Not surprised you don't understand.
I see you have returned to honor your father's legacy at last.
You are mistaken. My brother and I fight for each other and the future we might build together.
If that is all you desire, it is an embarrassment the Hashimoto cannot handle you themselves.
Do you miss your life before Overwatch? Training for your sport, your family, your home?
Absolutely. I never thought my journey would take me so far from those I love.
How do you manage?
The same way as you. We just do.
**swooning beeps**
I'm not quite sure what you said, but I know a compliment when I hear one.
**bashful beeps**
**melodic beeps**
Enough. One more note, and I'm putting that bird in a cage.
**horrified beeps**
What? You don't like that? Fine. Then I'll clip its wings instead.
Ashe, I've been thinking since Grand Mesa what you said about switching sides.
Uh-huh. And you realized Overwatch has been your real home all along.
No, not that. I'm thinking you might have a point.
Huh. Maybe they didn't brainwash you after all.
You disappoint me, Ramattra. A tactician such as yourself should know the consequences of breaking alliances.
And a mastermind such as you must know to always anticipate betrayal.
Torbjörn Lindholm harboring an Efi Oladele. Never thought I'd see the day.
**refuting beeps**
Ask him yourself, but it's not my story to tell.
Fighting's about to start. Time to do what they built you for
**cautious, inquiring beeps**
They think you're still a killing machine, even if you're wearing a hat.
With the return of Toshiro sensei, Asa sensei seems happier than before.
In my eyes, she is just as stormy as I remember.
Think again, brother. She did not beat us with a sword at the moment we greeted her.
Hm. An astute observation.
Seeing Keiko's family reunited makes me think of mother. I hope she's well.
Genji, let us not speak of her.
Is it so wrong to lament her absence?
She wanted nothing more than to be rid of the Shimada name. We must honor that.
I'm sure Toshiro sensei would be willing to repair your old sword.
No. That chipped blade must serve as an eternal reminder of my wrongdoing.
But, without its Shimada master, the dragon within will slumber forever.
I know. It deserves to be laid to rest.
It appalled me to see what dismal blades Toshiro sensei crafted for the Hashimoto.
Yes, I am glad he no longer has to stifle his creativity.
Kiriko's faith in her friends clouded my judgment. I should have listened to my instincts about you.
I'm sorry. I hope helping break out Genji and Toshiro-san proves that.
That is the only reason I have not yet cut you down.
I always wondered how Sakura's intel was so accurate. You were feeding her Hashimoto's secrets the whole time.
Actually, that was all her. Don't let my mistakes shake your faith in the other yokai.
Second one of those junkers starts giving you trouble, just let me know, will you?
**appreciative beeps**

conversations.name: More than we are made for

lines.subtitles: Folks get the wrong idea about you often, Bastion.
**sad, affirmative beep**
But you can't let it get you down. We're more than we're made for.
Do you really go digging for bits of old pottery?
Of course. They're called shards, and they're amazing.
What could be amazing about broken junk?
The story it tells when you put it back together.
You know, my parents were soldiers, too.
Really? You must be proud of all they fought for.
Pride's in short supply. I'm not wasting it on them.
Can you make the sound of a vicuña?
**vicuña noises**
That was pretty close. I'm impressed.
Before everything happened, Chiyo and I carried potatoes through the mountains together. I miss those days.
If you recently upgraded my weight-bearing capacity, perhaps I could carry potatoes for you.
That would be nice.
I made another blunder during training. Was I not meant for this?
Stop questioning yourself. If you were not proficient, we would not have you join the fight.
I want to get over Mizuki's past with the Hashimoto, but I don't know if I can.
Forgiveness heals the forgiver, Kiriko. You will find the peace when you learn to let go.
If he truly is worth forgiving, he should not expect you to.
So, what would it take for you to let someone ride you into battle?
There are two conditions. They must be worthy, and they must ask nicely.
Mhm, bad news for Hanzo, then.
Sloan, my dear friend, have you recovered anything else from that vault?
Have I ever? It's going to take years to go through all these artifacts.
Well, I hope you don't get buried under all that documentation.
I heard you live under knowledge itself. What more could they have hoped for?
I wonder how you'd look busting a move.
Sometimes imagination should take precedence over reality.
Woah, a Bastion unit. Big fan of the carnage you guys dish out.
**nervous protesting beeps**
Don't be shy. Take the credit where it's due.
I heard you ran into my little buddy Sloan out in the Atlantic.
Ugh, yes, that intolerable vagrant. Oh, if only they had sunk with all their trinkets.
Next time they bother you, just smash some old pottery. That really gets them heated.
Nothing like a few bullets to kick off a party. Am I right?
Oh, yes. A little mayhem always revs my engine.
You were asleep for a long time, too, weren't you?
**nodding beeps**
Well, we don't have to be lonely anymore. Not with all the friends we have in Overwatch.
**excited beeps**
How did you survive the years after the crisis?
**snoring beeps**
That's rather a long nap.
I see you survived. What a pity.
I am difficult to kill.
Until you're not.
You let your empire slip through your fingers. Strength wasted.
And your allegiance crumbled the moment it was tested.
It was a liability masked as opportunity. If I stayed, we would both be obsolete.
Though we could not reach an accord here, Zenyatta, it still meant a great deal to see you again.
Our roads may lead us apart, Ramattra, but you will always be my brother.
What are we waiting for? The more time we waste, the harder it'll be to put Vendetta down.
I will not approach this fight in overconfidence. We will have one chance, and we will make it count.
All right, warriors. Are we ready to achieve victory at all costs?
**eager beeps**
Huh. I will take that as a yes.
Zarya Volskaya, do you remember all the tricks we learned together?
How could I forget? Let's show them what we can do.
You still know how to rain bullets, don't you? I think our enemies might look better bullet-ridden.
**refusing beeps**
I don't like your tone, E54.
What's Vendetta complaining for? She got her sword. The other ones were inferior anyway.
Let it out, Shi-Shi. Really stick it to her.
That anima could rip her armor to pieces. She'd be nothing without the Hashimoto!
I know. She's totally cramping your style!
I love that you have two hearts. One for each of my pistols to shoot clean through.
And a gal with no heart is just my type.
It's time to stand down, Vendetta. Overwatch took out your allies in Tokyo and we won't stop there.
If you believe I cannot survive a single loss, then you have misjudged my competence to a fatal degree.
Could never fault your confidence, Zarya. I think it's rubbed off on all our new recruits, too.
Confidence makes victory. Victory makes confidence. It is not so hard to understand.
When you put it that way, it really isn't.
So, what's the plan to take down Vendetta?
There is no plan.
But, you always have a plan. We have to do something.
And we will. When the time is right, Vendetta's empire will be felled by action, not schemes.
You may not have accomplished all that I desired, but what you did deliver shows great potential.
Potential? I handed you carnage in a pretty package.
It takes more than a honed edge to earn my praise. A weapon must prove itself in battle.
You should thank the Wayfinders for fishing up those artifacts after you tried to sink them.
Ah, they're still intact. Perhaps I ought to repossess them.
Not on, lady. Those relics were never yours to begin with.
Oh, hey. That symbol on your chest, I've seen that before.
You have? Where?
I think it was in a ruin in Greece, or maybe Kenya? Wait, wait, it'll come to me.
Yeah. Take your time.
Hey, you noticing our names start the same way? You know, Venture, Vendetta.
You are never to speak to me again. Do you understand?
Oh, uh, yes, ma'am. Sorry, ma'am.
Yeah, no sweat, team. I'll have those baddies out of commission before you can say radiocarbon dating.
Radiocarbon dating?
Wait, no fair. I was ready.
In my country, they tell a crazy story about you. I must know if it is true.
I don't see what's so remarkable about doing surgery on yourself in a blizzard.
The knitting needle and the bear? Unfortunately, yes.
It was only an 8 kilometre shot. I've done better since.
To be fair, the wolf bit me first.
I knew it.
Anran, I hear you don't have a spotter! We should synchronize our gym schedules.
I'd love that! I feel so motivated when I watch you train.
Well, that makes two of us.
It is rare to find such discipline in someone so young. I commend you.
That's just how I was trained. It's nothing special.
Wrong. Take the compliment, girl.
I once had a cat like you. My sisters and I would bring her on ice fishing trips.
**eager meowing**
That coat won't keep you warm enough. But all that blubber might do the trick.
You should not judge all humans for the actions of a rotten few.
Strange advice from the woman with wires still caught in her portrait.
I've learned better than to blame omnics for what my people went through.
Well, I'm so glad you got something out of all those years of hatred.
The world's hardships have steeled you. But there is still kindness in your eyes.
Save it, bot. You're not the first to lecture me.
Not the first, and I hope for your sake not the last.
Genji, I bring good news. I have plans with someone special this Valentine's Day.
Oh. Who?
His name is Zenyatta.
Master.
You have changed much about yourself since your awakening.
Why stay in a form humans built? There's no beauty in their crude design.
Perhaps true beauty is found within, sister.
You lost me at sister, monk.
You know, the first year without my mom... it was real hard. Didn't open up for a while.
I did not have the luxury of time to grieve. My family needed my strength.
And now they're grown! When it comes to feeling your feelings, it's better late than never.
I... I will keep that in mind.
So... why did we really stop writing? I know my sketch wasn't that terrible.
Conflict got in the way. It is as you say: "war takes every happiness".
An unfortunate truth. But... we're still friends, aren't we?
Nothing could ever take that from us.
You've been with Overwatch a long time. Any advice for a new recruit?
Hmm... never lose sight of your teammates.
Well, you're the last person I'd expect to hear that from!
It is important to learn from our mistakes.
You'll like this one: How does a non-binary ninja take out a target?
Uh... how?
How?
I'll bite. How?
They slash them!
Oh. They should try shurikens too.
I suppose I've heard worse jokes.
Oh, good one! Bet you a hundred yen Genji doesn't get it.
Ajaraka mokuren tekerettsuno pa!
Um... Gesundheit?
I was trying to get rid of that grim Reaper for you, but... he's still here.
*(annoyed grumble)*
You gonna reap souls without a scythe?
Guns get the job done. If you'd ever fired one, you'd know.
Okay, hand me yours. Let's see what I can do.
Overwatch is back. I'm surprised you aren't to blame.
I have plenty of trouble without dredging up old mistakes.
Hmph. We finally agree on something.
Gabriel Reyes... I know that name. Soldier 24, right?
Nobody calls me that anymore.
Well, I'm not about to call you "Reaper".
Then... don't call me anything.
Cheers love! It's time to save the world!
Oh, what? Again?
It's a perfect day for some mayhem!
That's what I am always sayin'!
Ugh. Entered my passcode too quick and now I'm locked out of my phone!
I can unlock it for you, cariño.
Thanks, love! Oh-- wait. You tryna pull a fast one on me?
Hm. You're smarter than you look.
I happened upon some artifacts in an old necropolis. Would you care to look after them?
Would I?!
I should warn you, they might be cursed...
Ah! Even better!
No way... you're Echo! Like, Mina Liao's Echo! Oh, I have so many questions for you!
I... suppose I could answer them.
Awesome! I don't even know where to start, uh, I mean, um... what was she like?
She was... like me.
I understand you study omnic archaeology.
It's only my favorite specialization!
What do you know of the Awakening? Could Aurora's sentience be replicated?
That one... might be beyond my expertise.
...and, unlike with base 10, you begin at the rightmost number and work left.
Right. But... when did you pick your pronouns? Did you... download those?
Do you believe we are discussing "non-binary", rather than the binary counting system?
Oh! Uh... yeah.
Better watch it, kid, or those relics might end up in my pocket.
Don't do that! You don't even know their cultural value!
Uh, I know the value of 'a lot of money'.
Well... I know the value of... 'bopping you on the head'!
When are you gonna give me my cut of all those treasures?
When are you gonna stop being a big doofus?!
You first.
You second! Oh... shoot.
You're a geneticist? If you're up for it, I bet our bioarchaeology team would love to have you!
The dead tell intriguing tales. But my interest lies with the living.
Hey! ¡Quiúbole, Gabrielito! How's it hangin'?
What did you call me?
"Gabrielito"! That's your nickname, right?
*(growl)* Sombra...
So... you haven't been in touch since Ilios.
Be patient, escuincle. You aren't the only piece in this puzzle.
But what kind of puzzle? Lockbox, ancient riddle, jigsaw?
*(sigh)* Whatever kind makes you stop asking questions.
You might've gotten away from me once, but I won't quit until you're both behind bars.
*(chuckle)* I'm working with the world's best bounty hunter. Good luck tracking us down.
If your tracking skills are like the security at Grand Mesa, I expect I'll be fine.
The Naughton Vault requires top security clearance. How'd you get your intel?
Sorry, kid. Confidentiality's just as important in my line of work as it is in yours.
Then as a professional, you know I have to get answers.
Let this one go. For your own good.
Ooh... I think I went a bit overboard on the weights yesterday.
Pace yourself! That's what I always tell Reinhardt. Not that he ever listens.
Hey, can I look at the wings on your suit again?
I thought you preferred to stay on the ground.
It's for a different idea I had. I-I just thought the view from up there would be... inspirational.
Hey, rocket lady... do they make that suit in my size?
*laughter* Oh, you couldn't handle one of these.
Why not?! I was born to fly...
I see your sneakers. You, me, the basketball courts later.
Sure. But I don't play without stakes.
Likewise. What are you willing to lose?
Oh, Pharah-chan... I've never lost.
I don't work with criminals.
What's right isn't always what's legal.
Then you change the laws.
Heh, easy for you to say.
I think I'm going to get a chihuahua.
You're joking.
Why, what's wrong with chihuahuas?
Uh, well, for starters, they aren't corgis.
Can't believe Ana Amari's kid took up with mercenaries like Helix.
Oh, as opposed to, whatever you are?
Y'know, Fareeha, it's not a sign of weakness if you take it easy sometimes.
Mistakes arise when people turn careless.
*(sigh)* Like mother, like daughter...
Just like we practiced, Amari: I pull them together, you blow them up!
I'm not waiting, I'm going to blow them up right away!
Yes, but when I pull them together, then you blow them up especially.
Better watch your back, now. Helix is going to wipe your whole operation off the map.
I reckon they'll try. But when I'm through, the West'll be wild again.
How are you liking working with Overwatch, Sierra?
Oh, it's amazing! Y'all are so smart, and kind, and... well, nothing beats working with heroes!
*chuckle* That's exactly what I've been hearing about you, too.
I've had my problems with Helix, but I'll be damned if they don't train up some real sharpshooters.
Careful now, cowboy. That's almost a compliment.
I think you could use an adventure, Mei! You ever hike Mount Washington?
No, but I've read about it. They have such interesting weather patterns there.
Yeah, and the fog stretches for miles. I'll take you with me next time.
I'm glad you joined us. We're going to need all the help we can get to take Talon down.
Hah, my mom always told me to stand up for what's right. And it doesn't get much more wrong than Talon.
So what exactly are you looking to learn about Jack Morrison?
Honestly? Whatever you've got.
You were the Enhancement Program's best soldier. There's gotta be something you can tell me.
The Naughton project's ancient history. It's been shut down for decades.
Your "ancient history" is all I've got to go on.
Trust me, kid: the last thing you need is my past catching up to you, too.
You know, you're not the only one chasing down leads. Maybe we can help each other.
Some things stay buried for a reason. Digging them up can get you killed.
Yeah? When did that ever stop you?
Guess that's fair.
Whoof, Dorothy's looking a little worse for wear after that last mission...
Just swing by my workshop after this. I'll patch her up.
Wow! You mean it, Dr. Lindholm? That'd be amazing!
Please, Dr. Lindholm is my wife!
You still have any contacts with Los Muertos?
I might. What's in it for me?
I'd offer you money, but I don't think that's what you're after.
No. So... any good stories about the cowboy?
You'll never guess what I heard when I tapped the Hashimoto's calls.
I don't do guesses. What's your price?
*(tongue click)* I have a feeling we're going to get along.
That fox girl asked for more Hashimoto intel. Think I should tell her the truth?
Only if you're prepared to regret it.
Your friends might be fooled by your little act, but I know a liar when I see one.
I'm not lying. Just not telling the whole truth.
Sure, whatever helps you sleep at night.
Peeked at your grades. Pretty good for someone studying through a Null Sector attack.
Thanks! Honestly, I'm pretty proud of-- oh, HEY! That's private!
Not to me.
Jamison Fawkes, channel nine news. Mr. Gunbot, sir, how do you think the battle's going to go?
**excited, talkative beeps**
Could you repeat that in words? Hold on, breaking news! The moon has fallen into the ocean!
Can I get a beat?
**beep-boxes**
**beep-boxes**
Haha, perfect! You're the best.
One stick o' dynamite? Well, that's just adorable.
BOB!
I meant admirable! Admirable!
You rob any trains in your day?
Argh, they get all gummed up together in a big pile when I try!
...You're supposed to stop them first.
I do stop them. I think my problem is that I stop them a little too hard...
What's on your mind, mate?
I am thinking of what I have lost.
What, your keys? Arrows? Snacks? I've got snacks. Cheer up!
We should do a concert together.
Oh, what do you play?
I sing. Laaaa... *continues singing*
I sing. La la la la la la... *singing scales*
I-I sing! *high operatic singing*
I sing. Figaro, figaro-figaro-figaro-figaro, figaro... ooh-ooooh!
Wow. Yeah, uh... I'll have to get back to you on that.
*half-whispering:* Look, he's the strangest bot I've ever seen. That's all I'm sayin'.
Strangeness is in the eye of the beholder.
Oh no, he heard me. This is so awkward...
Jamison Fawkes, interviewing this fancy robot. Any wisdom to share with us as the battle begins?
Victory goes to those who maintain their focus.
Boring! Back to you, Natasha—any car chases we could watch?
Dr. Zhou. Did Captain Opara make it back as well?
I'm afraid not.
*(sigh)* He was a good man.
He thought the same about you.
Dr. Zhou! You've made quite the name for yourself.
Oh, thank you! I think there's always more to learn.
Quit being so humble. Nothing wrong with being proud of your work!
I may have another opportunity to travel to Rio de Janeiro. Do you have any feedback for the board?
Yeah, I do. Stay out of my city.
Do my eyes deceive me, or are you wearin' skates?
Nice skates. Very cute. You goin' to swap those out before we get to the gunfight?
Y'all, our teammate is wearin' skates. To a gunfight! Hahaha!
You'll see what these can do!
Time to settle who's the best shot.
There is no competition. I was trained by the best.
And I was trained by the West.
**sighs** Americans.
That rifle is a fine piece of work. Looks a little unwieldy, though
Perhaps in the hands of an amateur
You remind me of myself when I was younger.
Uh, I'm way cooler than you!
That's exactly what I would've said! All you're missin' is the hat and cigar.
Weighted like a stone. Blade, sharpened - yearns to punish. Strikes the final blow.
Swifter than the wind. A rushing crimson river. Stains the earth with red.
**groans** You're reciting your haikus out loud again...
The Shimada weapons were masterworks, but those ofuda were your father's magnum opus.
He made them for grandma when he proposed. Bringing the fox spirit to life really won her over.
A sentimental, yet powerful gift. I see why she was impressed.
Is it true that my dad had to keep the fox spirit a secret from the clan?
Indeed. He was forbidden from crafting more anima avatars after forging our dragons.
Why? You used them to help people.
The scenes that haunt my memories... prove otherwise.
Do you think Genji will ever come back?
Have faith, Kiriko. The years have changed us all, but he will return just as I have.
Have you heard from your father?
A little. It's been harder to contact him since you escaped the Hashimoto.
I did not wish to make matters worse for him. I'm sorry.
**reassuring sigh** Don't be. I'm sure he's just glad you're back.
The Hashimoto run hourly patrols. We can sneak into the castle when they change shifts.
I am... impressed. Your preparations are quite diligent.
Well, I had to kill time until someone came back...
Right. Then I will make your patience worthwhile.
My mom wants to know if you've kept up with the sword.
I swore... never to wield a blade again.
Mm. I'll tell her you're thinking of picking it back up.
Send my greetings to... Asa-sensei.
You can say hi yourself.
In the mood to follow my orders today, Song?
If those orders involve me wrecking the bad guys, you bet!
*(chuckles)* I'll see what I can do.
So... how is that man you were telling me about?
Angela, I'm not discussing my love life on a mission.
Lúcio, have you ever written lyrics before?
I've dabbled a bit. What's up?
I was wondering if you would look at... Actually, I'm going to work on it a bit more.
Listened to your album the other day.
Oh, uh... did you like it?
Not sure there was enough bass. I could almost hear the other sounds.
Ha! I'll crank it up next time.
You check out the new Antler Antler album?
You've heard of them?
Yeah. So... what'd you think?
Nobody uses fifteen electric guitars like those guys!
You've come a long way since joining Overwatch. I'm thankful to have your support.
Aw, back at'cha! It's all about relying on each other.
To give into impulse is to give up control.
**questioning meows**
That is to say, please refrain from swatting the orbs.
**pouty meows**
So, how'd you pull all those heists?
Bombs!
Uh huh. And...?
Was-- w-was there supposed to be another step?
Get this: more bombs!
Bought another Lucky Lucky Good Luck Amulet. I have a good feeling about today.
I hope you don't buy those often. Pretty sure they're a scam.
Every week since I got to Kanezaka.
See... this is why you're broke.
Kiriko. I really need your help.
What's wrong?
I lost this week's Lucky Lucky Good Luck Amulet...
There, there. I'll pray for you later.
Not sure Hanzo likes me much.
Oh, don't take it personal. He thinks everyone's suspicious.
Aw, but I'm such a stand-up guy. You trust me, right?
Uh... not when you say it like that...
Tell Ryōta to stop tagging on Hashimoto turf. If they catch him, he's screwed.
Mizuki... You're actually a huge softie, aren't you?
Quit messing around. Don't you know what they do to people that piss them off?
Relax, I'll talk to him. It's just funny you try to hide how much you care.
Where were you last night? Chikasa said she couldn't get a hold of you.
If I told you, I'd have to kill you.
Ugh. Can't you answer normally for once?
Nah. I like making you mad.
Your new hat looks lighter. Nobuto did a good job.
Yeah, I like it. Wish it was a little more lowkey, though.
Right? If the Hashimoto find out what he can make, they'll paint a target on his back for sure.
They do love a fashion statement.
You have a bandage?
Who exactly do you think I am?
Someone who carries bandages? Guess not.
Yikes... You look cheery.
**scoff** As cheery as you are significant.
Angela! **chuckle** I can call you Angela, right?
For you? Doctor Ziegler.
Aw... I'm a little hurt... "Doctor".
Dr. Ziegler, you should join us next time we run drills! I feel like I only ever see you in the lab.
I'm better at working than training. Why not ask Commander Chase?

I find the company more agreeable these days.
I always thought you would understand better than most the duality of human existence.
I am at peace with it. I suspect you will be forever unsatisfied.
You wouldn't believe what I learned about you, Sparrow.
I am at peace with who I was. Your threat does not concern me.
What is it like to have the chance to change the past?
Sometimes it doesn't want to change.
Do not blame yourself for Mondatta's death. It was not your fault.
You don't understand Genji, I could have saved him. Maybe the world would have been better off if it had been me instead of him.
Genji, this is just like old times.
Our paths cross for now. As to the future, we shall see.
I always liked working with you, Winston. No awkward small talk.
Always liked working with you, too. You have a... great sense of humor!
How do I trust a man who is half machine?
The heart of a man still beats inside of me.
Does the suffering of the omnics here trouble you, Master?
It does. My brother, Mondatta, gave much to improve their lives, but it was not to be.
It is good to fight alongside one of my brightest pupils.
And you, master.
I am grateful to be here, my master.
How was your reunion with your brother?
He's still not ready for time to flow forward again.
You remind me of someone... You're so serious, though!
I believe you are mistaken.
Where did you hide your treasure? You could hardly have it on your person!
Treasure? S-sure, I don't know anything you're talking about.
Order and discipline. That is the only way to live.
I sense a kindred spirit.
I would take my bow against your rifle any day.
That would be the last mistake you ever made.
Talon could restore your family's empire.
But at what cost?
I sense within you the same rage that once consumed your brother.
We are nothing alike!
What difference is there between The Witch's magic and your alchemy?
Alchemy is a science. Her magic... is something darker.
I sense that you and The Soldier have history together.
Indeed, and much of it unhappy.
What reason brings you to travel so far from home?
I was banished from my home for taking my brother's life. I can never return.
I once met a man, who could summon a dragon as you do.
Impossible! Only my clan possesses the skill. My brother could, but he is dead.
Any chocolates today, brother?
Those were *your* amusements, not mine.
And I thought I'd taken my licks.
I was a reckless youth... but you are something else entirely.
Brrr... I get cold just looking at you.
Then you should look somewhere else.
Bots, dime a dozen.
Actually, Efi spent most of her Adawe Foundation grant on me. It was not inexpensive.
You look like the kind of guy who could use something blown up!
A candidate just came to mind.
Junkrat, you're a reckless lunatic.
Oh, thank you very much.
You hook 'em, I'll cook 'em.
...Shut up.
Try and stay out of trouble for once.
I'll be on me best behavior.
I'll hook 'em!
And I'll cook 'em!
Don't blow it.
When have I ever... Er, don't answer that.
**sighs** Remember that time we stole the crown jewels? All hail King Jamison Fawkes the First! And, um... Duke Roadhog? Uh, what is your name, anyways?
Mako.
Hey Torbs! Can we trade arms?
I don't think they're compatible.
Cheers, mate! The cavalry's here!
That's my line!
Think I could have a look at one of those bombs of yours?
Over my dead body!
And I thought I was supposed to be the comic relief.
**angry squeaks**
Hey...
You know, I never would have taken you for someone with such a homely home.
If you don't like it, stay in your room.
Keep your stuff off the table.
I'm hurt! I am nothing if not a courteous house guest.
Lúcio, can I have your autograph?
Aw, you're making me blush, Mei! Need one for Snowball, too?
Orisa, you are amazing! Could you ask Efi if she could help me out with my helmet sometime?
I am sure she would love to. She is a big fan of your music. As am I.
You should come to Rio, Orisa. I could use your help with those Vishkar goons.
I do not know about this Vishkar, but I am programmed to assist where I can.
What do you think, Pharah? Got time for a game?
After the mission, you're on.
What you Vishkar will never understand is that people should be free!
What you call freedom is an illusion that causes more harm than good.
Vishkar's using you, just like they used my father. You just wait. You'll see.
Your father was a Vishkar employee. He understood our company's vision. A shame he never educated you.
To think I should have to work with a street ruffian.
I'm not all that excited about this arrangement either.
Vishkar is building a better future for humanity.
You believe that? I don't even know what to tell you.
You should return what you stole from Vishkar.
Stole? Psh! You need to go ask your bosses where it all came from; then we can talk.
Such intriguing sonic displacement technology.
Thanks, my dad invented it. You two would get along great!
Can't keep up?
Then stay out of our way!
Lúcio! I'll race ya!
Oh, you're on.
Hey, Tracer, you and Emily wanna hit the slopes some time?
Absolutely!.. If you think you can keep up with us!
Winston, how's it hangin'?
Uhm, okay, I guess. We got this big mission coming up-- Oh, I get it.
I've been thinking about my football name. Ready? How about... Winston. What do you think?
I... Like it!
Winston! Started on your Halloween costume yet?
Actually, I have! I was thinking of a safari costume. Haha, you thought I wasn't going to have one, didn't you?
Hey, McCree, do you know what time it is?
lines.modernSubtitles: Hey, do you know what time it is?

lines.subtitles: Well, I'd say it's about... now I see what you're doing there!
You're just a no-good bully. How can you even look at yourself in the mirror?
That's cold!
I beg your pardon! I consider myself a freedom fighter, a... misunderstood one.
Doctor Ziegler, I don't think you've aged a day since I last saw you.
And neither have you, Mei.
Mei, you haven't aged a day. What's your secret?
Cryostasis. But I'm not sure if I'd recommend it.
Dr. Zhou. I'm interested in your colleagues' research into the long term effects of cryogenic freezing.
Oh, well, yes, I'm sure, maybe... **bursts into tears**
The front lines are no place for a scientist.
I guess it's a good thing I have you to watch my back.
I was wondering if I could take a look at your little robot.
I suppose so... just keep that hammer to yourself.
Tracer, you're so amazing! You inspire me.
Mei, you're the real hero!
Aren't you warm wearing all that?
Yes. But it's too late to change!
I love your glasses, so cute!
Oh, uhm, thanks. I like yours, too.
**giggles** We should compare notes some time.
That would be great! What's your opinion on the Tobelsteins' gravitational models?
Mei, if you don't have anything else going on, you should come celebrate the holidays with Tracer, Emily, Athena and me!
I'd love to! We could have hot pot!
Winston, what are your plans for the holidays?
You should come to Gibraltar with Tracer, Emily, Athena and me!
Zarya? How can you even pick up all that weight?
I lift as well as I lift because it cannot be avoided.
Zarya? I don't understand how you can fight in the cold wearing so little.
I'll tell you my secret if you give me your coat.
Look at all the snow! We should make snow angels!
Why are you looking at me, Mei?
I got you some chocolates, Genji. Swiss, they're the best!
Thank you, Angela. Perhaps you could share them with me?
Angela, I have some chocolates for you. ...Not Swiss.
**sigh** I suppose it will have to do. Thank you, Genji.
Lúcio, I never realized your father was the one who invented Vishkar's sonic technology.
The Core Tech was his life's work, owned and patented by Vishkar. But it's mine now.
Describing your work as unethical would be a kindness.
But the true question is whether or not you can deny my discoveries... No. I didn't think so.
I know we have our differences, but your brilliant mind would be welcome amongst my colleagues in Oasis.
No thank you. You and your colleagues discredit the field of science. I want nothing to do with it.
Keep the skies clear for me.
Let's keep the skies clear together!
Pharah, your mother always hoped you'd follow in her footsteps.
She did? Funny, she never mentioned that to me.
Pharah, if your mother could see you now, I think she'd be proud of you.
There's a first time for everything, I guess.
Reinhardt, don't you think it's time you hung it up? You're not getting any younger.
Never! I will fight to my last breath.
Reinhardt. I don't approve of you dragging that poor girl around on your adventures.
Brigitte has made her choice. I would have her at my side.
Angela, you should know that no one could stop Brigitte from doing something she had her mind set on. She is a Lindholm after all.
Reinhardt, what are your plans for the holidays?
I'll probably visit Torbjörn's family in Gothenburg, like the last few years.
Doc, I've been having the worst headaches.
I've always said you should get your head examined.
**sighs** Torbjörn, I miss Ingrid's apple pie at the holidays.
**chuckles** Well, it just so happens she has some saved for you.
Well, I suppose I'll be patching you up... as usual
Don't worry Dr. Ziegler, if I get in trouble, I'll just recall!
Winston, are you experiencing any issues with your genetic therapy?
Other than a crippling addiction to peanut butter?
Zenyatta, I must admit, I do not understand how your healing works.
And I do not understand much of how you heal, Dr. Ziegler. I suppose we must all take some things on faith.
Well, I must never worry about my safety when the brave agents of Helix are with us.
Don't be so sure about that.
Your condition seems relatively stable.
No one's accused me of *that* in a long time.
Your body seems to be adapting well to the changes, Gabriel.
This is what you'd call "well".
Why am I being subjected to this agony?
No need to thank me. I only saved your life.
You were a disgrace to Overwatch. If I had known what Reyes had been planning, I would have never allowed it.
It seems to me that it was convenient for you not to look too closely into Gabriel's business.
Started any wars lately?
I'd have to check my schedule.
Look at this world, Symmetra. See what science has wrought?
Of course. Science obeys the laws of nature. It is only to be expected.
Your state of chronal uncertainty is fascinating to me, Tracer. I do wish you would allow me to study you.
While I'm truly touched by your offer, **nervous laugh** I think I'll have to pass... **nervous **
How are you feeling, Lacroix?
I don't feel. That's the point, isn't it?
Winston, you were never frustrated at the restrictions Overwatch placed on your research?
Of course. But sometimes, a measure of caution is needed in a scientist.
Overwatch had good reason to shut down your research.
I shouldn't be surprised at such a narrow opinion coming from a *jumped. Up. Ape.*
I must know how your technology functions.
Existence is mysterious, isn't it?
Orisa, you grow stronger each time I see you.
My artificial intelligence makes it possible to learn from my experiences and from everything I observe.
Orisa, you are adorable!
I will pass your feedback onto Efi, I believe that she will be pleased!
Reinhardt, I have allocated my learning processes towards analyzing your combat performance.
What an odd compliment.
Reinhardt, why is your shield so important to you?
It is a reminder - of my duty.
I wonder what's locked up in that brain of yours...
My systems are protected by state of the art **unintelligible**
Torbjörn Lindholm, you are responsible, in part, for my creation.
Why does that feel like an accusation?
I consider Reinhardt to be the model upon which I have based my own behaviors.
What a terrifying thought!
Tracer, is it wrong for us to operate outside the law?
That's a difficult question, Orisa. I think there are times when you just have to do what's right.
Tell Efi if she’s ever in Gibraltar she should look me up.
Efi would be honored to be able to meet such an accomplished scientist and a member of Overwatch.
Zarya, I have learned to utilize my graviton charge by watching you.
Your compliment is unwanted.
Do you have any dreams, my friend?
I do not dream as humans do. But it is my desire to become the hero Efi believes that I am.
Tekhartha Zenyatta, I wish to learn about the Iris.
I would be happy to teach you. It is rare that I meet one with such an unformed mind.
Reinhardt, are we still on for ice-fishing? You're not still sore about last year, are you?
Last year? Heh, I'll show you! I'll catch *twice* as many as you this year!
My New Years resolution? Actually take that time off.
That'll be the day...
Your mother would've been proud of you.
You didn't know my mother very well, then.
I'm keeping an eye on you, Soldier: 76.
When have I heard that before?
Pharah, ever wonder why you were never accepted into Overwatch? Almost like someone didn't want you to join.
Have you ever considered getting a new hobby?
Hey, Torbjörn, check out my new suit. Mark VI. State of the art.
**clears throat** Jump jets... concussion rockets... **grumbles** Well, yes, it's looking pretty good.
You know, Fareeha, I could take a look at fixing up your suit if you'd like.
And mess it up with a bunch of scrap metal bolted on the side? No thanks. I like it the way it is.
Fareeha, any plans for the winter?
I'm flying home to see my dad.
I'm going to head to Canada to see my dad.
You're so lucky, Tracer. Ever since I was a little girl, I dreamed of joining Overwatch.
Maybe you'll still get your chance. Who knows what the future holds?
Tracer, have you thought about joining Helix? We could always use a good pilot.
Aw, I'm flattered, really, but I have some other things occupying my time now.
Pharah. Your mother was a hero to me. To all of us.
You probably knew her better than me.
An omnic in my squad took his own life, rather than be controlled by an AI.
A noble, but tragic sacrifice. I hope that you will honour it.
Aren't you supposed to be dead?
Didn't take.
One of these days, someone's going to put an end to you.
I invite them to try.
Well, you sure take to this bad guy thing easily, don't you?
And you sure know how to play boy scout.
Try to stick to the plan, Sombra.
Look, someone has to be ready when all your careful planning doesn't pan out.
So what are we doing here, boss?
I need to pay a visit to a friend.
Always a mystery with you.
Looks like we're working together again.
Let's hope it goes better than the time at the museum.
I don't understand how you can trust Sombra.
I don't. But Sombra has her uses, and I know what she's been up to.
Poor Winston. Has to hide away so he doesn't scare the children.
I don't even think children are afraid of you.
Just like old times, eh, Reinhardt?
We old-timers must stick together, teach these kids a thing or two! Hehahaha!
I was wondering if you'd sign something for me... it's **clears throat** for a friend.
Of course! Here you go. Love, D.Va.
Aww. After this match is over. Right now, it's time to get serious!
The destruction caused by the omnics here... It reminds me of home.
Seeing what happened after the war here gives me hope for the rebuilding of my country.
Things can be destroyed, but as long as the people are strong, they can always be rebuilt.
Reinhardt, we need to find you some new tunes.
What's wrong with the classics? I love Hasselhoff! Have you heard Night Rocker?
Armor? How positively medieval.
I will take that as a compliment, my lady!
Last I checked, I didn't ask for your opinion
You always did take good care of my armor!
Just try to keep it in one piece for once.
I sometimes wonder if all that armor slows your brain down.
Ja. And I sometimes wonder if your *height* is why you're always in such a bad mood.
Ah, could you say that again? Sometimes it's hard to hear you all the way down there!
Reinhardt. Least number of eliminations buys the post-mission drinks?
**laughs** Let's show these kids how it's done.
Agreed! Let the best man win.
How's Brigitte doing? Keeping everything in working order?
A knight could not ask for more from his squire!
You need to stop telling those ridiculous stories Reinhardt. No one believes they're real.
Ridiculous stories?! My tales of adventure and glory are all true!
Even the one about the mad doctor and the witch?
Especially that one!
You know, Torbjörn, you would make an *excellent* Santa Claus! Ho, ho, ho!
Maybe this year you can be the elf. I think Ingrid's been working on something.
Reinhardt! You'd better not be filling my daughter's head with stories.
Ah, she hardly listens to them anyways.
Ah! Winston! It's up to us to keep our comrades safe!
I'll be right behind you, sir.
Reinhardt. You said you would arm wrestle me. Nervous?
Nervous? *Me?* Never!
Keep training, and maybe someday you can learn to handle a real weapon!
I think I've got this, old man.
That hammer doesn't look so heavy.
You won't believe the joke ol' pig face over there told me the other day. Roadhog?
Do you ever shut up?
You need to slow down; think about your actions.
Okay, Dad!
Think you can do my job, do you...
Someone has to.
Someone's going to put a stop to your illegal activities.
You're one to talk! You and your friends are breaking the law, same as me.
Ah, you'd make a good barista, Bastion.
**series of beeps**
Isn't it a little embarrassing to get beaten up by a monkey?
Have you ever been hit by a giant, genetically engineered gorilla? I could arrange it for you...
What's the plan today, Gabe? You don't mind if I call you Gabe, do you?
Stick to the mission.
What interesting things I've learned about your employers, Ms. Vaswani.
...*What* have you heard?
Don't think I don't recognize that device of yours. I know you stole it!
What can I say? A girl just has to have the latest tech.
Sometimes I feel a little sick after using my Translocator, I'm sure you know what I mean, Tracer.
Won't be a problem if you just disappear forever.
Ah, my favorite spider. I wonder what sort of web you're spinning now.
It'd be a shame if something happened to you on our next mission. A real pity.
Now I've seen it all. I'm suppose to work with a giant rat?
**hamster squeaks**
They don't pay me enough for this.
You remind me of my stuffed bear, Arturito.
**hamster squeaks**
I like him better.
Your friend, Katya Volskaya... What will you say when you learn the truth?
She's a hero to all Russians. I do not care what you have to say.
Katya Volskaya and Aleksandra Zaryanova... Traitors to your own country. You deserve each other.
I do what I must, for my people.
Helix should keep the peace in Vishkar developments.
We do not need an army to keep the peace. We prefer our own methods.
Hehe, there's something on your dress.
No, there isn't.
Symmetra, you speak of law and of order, but you must know that life is chaotic by its very nature.
Hmph. To be lectured about chaos and disorder from a machine.
What can you know of life?
Only that which I have observed, experienced and processed. All is one within the Iris.
Cassidy, what happened to your arm?
I always admired yours, figured I'd get one of my own.
Retirement suits you.
And I think a hammer upside your face would suit you!
Whoever built your mech did a good job. None of that AI mess.
Well, if you wanna give me some upgrades, I'm all ears!
My mechanic Dae-Hyun does a great job on it. I bet he'd love to meet you!
Winston, are you still using that silly feather duster of a gun?
Why don't you come over here and ask that again?
The suffering of my people rests heavily upon your shoulders, Torbjörn.
**sigh** Believe me, I don't need reminding.
I hear that you have taken in an omnic, Torbjörn.
I don't want to talk about it.
Tracer, you should be careful. We don't know the side-effects of using the chronal accelerator.
Considering the alternatives, I'm willing to take the risks.
Whacha lookin' at?
An annoyance.
Well, well, it looks like we will be working together.
Don't think I'm happy about that!
Does it bother you, knowing that you could have saved Mondatta's life?
We are all responsible for the choices we've made.
So predictable. Even when you reverse time, you always make the same decisions.
Don’t be so sure about that.
Winston! You're an animal! **giggles**
Empirical evidence suggests I'm a real animal.
Need any adjustments to your chronal accelerator?
I think— **mimics radio static** **giggles** Just kidding, Winston! It works great.
I guess they'll let anyone be a pilot these days!
**hamster squeaks**
Wow. It's an honor to meet a member of the Shambali. Mondatta was an inspiration to me.
To us all. I miss him greatly.
Hammond?
**hamster squeaks**
Hammond, how did you escape anyway?
**hamster squeaks**
What?! Well that explains the drag when I lifted off! I was sure that my calculations were correct.
We've been through a lot, escaping from the moon.
**hamster squeaks**
You're right, that would be much worse.
Winston, your gun is so cute. You should try playing with some real firepower.
I like to leave the heavy lifting to the professionals.
**hamster squeaks**
Indeed my friend, indeed...
How can I convince you that I am still a man?
I know what you are. I'm only sorry that you do not.
Russia has no need of Overwatch's assistance.
Overwatch made mistakes in the past, I hope we can fix them.
Tell me your thoughts, my friend.
**various beeps**
I've got my eye on you, omnic.
And I will watch your back in turn.
So this is where you grew up? You must show me around.
That was another life
You and Hana are pretty tight now.
Well, girls that hit the arcade stick together.
I'm a hardcore arcade girl. Does that earn me an invite?
Obviously! Someone's got to bump her to second on the leaderboards.
They might let a bot run things around here, but Junkertown would rip you to shreds!
*(scoff)* If I ever leave Japan, your little garbage pile is the last place I'd visit.
That story about losing your arm in a bike accident. Was that a lie, too?
Not entirely. There was a bike involved.
Still skirting around the details, huh?
I'm not trying to hide anything, Kiriko. It's just... really hard to talk about.
Mizuki did not choose his upbringing, brother. Try to see him for more than his mistakes.
Absolutely not. He should be punished for his failures.
As I was punished for mine.
Perhaps... a more tempered view would be best.
Of all your 'queen's' pawns, you seem the most cutthroat
I ain't her pawn
Perhaps not, but she plays you all the same
Remember that little jjimjilbang that we used to go to?
Duh! How could I forget?
It closed down! I had to find a new one.
Nooooo! They had the best naengmyeon!
You guys sure moved on fast after I left!
We changed strategies to survive, Hana. Not because we don't miss you.
Well, duh. *(giggle)* Of course you guys miss me.
Don't make me take that back.
You leaving MEKA squad feels like ages ago. We've all really changed since.
Sometimes it feels wrong that I found a home somewhere else.
Hana... you didn't actually leave us. You just grew. You're exactly where you should be.
MEKA is rather clever to make soldiers of their celebrities.
Uh, other way around. We're here to protect the people, not walk a runway.
Hmm, perhaps... though war can be quite glamorous once you clear away the rubble.
Finally, I've been relieved of my duty. Now Hana can drag you to the arcade instead.
Don't be like that. It's hard for her to find real competition to play with.
Wait. She sees me as real competition?
Yeah. But you didn't hear that from me.
The Junkers are a mess... but you actually seem kind of smart.
Oh yeah?
Or maybe you just don't talk enough for people to know.
*(heh)* Maybe.
I'm glad Toshiro-ojisan is safe now, but I wish we didn't have to blow up his forge.
He'll find a way to keep up his craft.
But that building held all his secrets.
No, he does. Isn't that why you guys bothered keeping him alive?
Was there ever a world where you'd have sold us out?
No. I realized pretty quick that I could never betray you guys.
Will you thank Nobuto for letting me keep the hat?
It's fine. Not like he would have made you give it back.
He doesn't want to hear from me, does he?
Can you blame him? You know what the Hashimoto did to his sister.
Brigitte... If you were me, how would you make a good impression on the team?
Oh, that's easy. Just let them try on your hat!
*(laughs)* That's pretty good. Wait, you're serious?
Well, it worked for Cassidy, so I'd say it's worth a shot!
Even in her own keep, Shion could not lead the Hashimoto to victory. How pitiful.
Better not let her hear you talking like that. She's killed for a lot less.
*(chuckle)* She could not best me. Rage as mindless as hers is a weakness I've long since overcome.
*(sigh)* Uh huh... whatever you say.
I always see you with that smiling onion.
Yeah? What about it?
Nothing. I think it's cute.
You must be ashamed, losing that boy to Overwatch. I suppose the Hashimoto do not value fealty as I do.
They can have his loyalty for all I care. As long as I control his fear, he's still mine!
What's wrong, cowboy? You miss Genji that bad?
*(chuckle)* He ain't the only one. Got a lot of old friends out there I've been thinking about lately.
You're not trapped here, Cole. I know you'd be doing good wherever you end up.
That makes one of us. But... nice of you to say.
Funny that guys with no loyalties keep ending up at Overwatch.
Guys? You mean it's not just me?
Oh, did I say that? Slip of the tongue.
That D.Va girl... she's got the juice! The shazow! She just flies right in, and blows everything up!
Sounds like you're a big fan.
Oh, I am! But... she was a fan of me, first, of course.
Sure. Probably got your posters on her wall and everything.

paths.label: Sure. Probably got your posters on her wall and…

lines.subtitles: Those dragons available to rent?
Absolutely not.
I want 'em swirling around the New Junk City arena. A proper lightshow for when we crown our champs.
Then have your foolish lackeys set off their little fireworks!
By the way, Chikasa says she forgives you.
Does anyone else?
You know the answer to that.
Well, thanks for letting me know.
Being looked up to, seen as a hero, relied on... you seem so put together.
The key word there is *seem*. I have my moments too.
Mizuki, Mizuki... when I get my hands on you, what ever shall I put you through?
Your words don't scare me anymore.
And what of my actions? How much pain does that body of yours remember?
Not as much as yours will if you come after me.
Why did you send Mizuki to Overwatch?
The agents there will not let him fall to his demons.
Huh... you really have a lot of faith in them.
I do. Because they never let me fall to mine.
Keep pushin' omnics around, and the Phreaks'll be coming for you.
*(cough)* Who are you?
I'm about to be the thorn in your side, big boy.
That's pig boy to you.
Sorry if this is a rude question, but are you capable of feeling regret?
I often ponder negative past events I can no longer change. Does that reflect the experience accurately?
Yeah. I'd say it does.
Why have you forsaken me? I taught you strength, I gave you a reason to live!
No. Toshiro-ojisan and the Yōkai did.
You think they still care for you after what you did? It's not too late to return to my side.
Never. I made my choice, and it wasn't you.
That thing's Beast?
Sure is.
Hm... Tokki's cuter.
Fate's made us enemies... but I reckon in a past life, we were thick as thieves. Just two kittens napping on a windowsill.
Yeah... not even in your dreams, dude.
Hana's lucky to have a friend like you in her corner, isn't she?
Yeah, well, someone needs to remind her when she needs to lock in.
*(sigh)* I do believe Satya's said the same of me.
It's time to make 'em bleed, Gracie.
**questioning meows**
What, your name's Gracie too? Funny, you look more like a Carnage!
**unamused meows**
Kiriko says she doesn't hate me for lying, but I bet she does.
I do not believe so. Though it will take time to earn her forgiveness.
How long did it take for you and Hanzo?
We have come a long way, but I suspect it is still a work in progress.
I commend you, Vaira. Your company's shielding has proven quite useful so far.
Of course! Paired with those new armaments, your victory is all but assured.
When Vishkar rebuilds, I expect a monument to my leadership.
Consider it done, my dear.
Prepare yourself, Subject Sigma. I will have need of you soon.
How soon is soon when time slips away? When moments become millennia?
Enough. Doctor O'Deorain will harness your power when the time is right.
The harness... yes. Of course.
I just know there's something terrible under that mask of yours.
*(wheeze)* None of your business.
Silly little piggy... Everything I want is my business.
One, two, C4 - no wait, wait for it.
*(grunts)*
Five, six, deton-eight! *(laughs)*
Saw there's a whole shop dedicated to your little pachis here... think they'll have that limited edition Piggy Mary?
Hope so.
Then you'll have it, my dear bosom friend! I'll even threaten the shopkeep if I have to!
Thanks.
We're doing it, Mako! We've got a ship, we've got a dream, and we're seeing the world!
Yup.
Where to next? One of them temples in Beijing? The sunlit shores of Santorini? Or maybe... maybe Missouri?
Ooh... Missouri.
My biggest dream is to set off a fantastical explosion, incinerate everything and everyone as the place is burnt to smithereens. What do you think?
I think that sounds like a nightmare.
Hey! Uh... you, um... you really... you're tall!
Uh huh.
HAHAHA! Oh, wow! And you're funny, too!
The Hashimoto don't stand a chance now that we're back together. Just don't run off on your own again, okay?
I will walk this path by your side, pocket ninja. I promise.
When I visit Genji in Japan, I'd better not find him hacked to pieces again.
If you do, it will not have been by my hand.
So... you'd let someone else hack him up, instead?
*(sighs)* That was not what I meant.
There was a tea leaf standing up in my cup this morning. That means good luck, right?
Not if you tell me! Ugh... You ruined it for yourself.
When I think of what you put Mizuki through, I feel sick to my stomach.
Oh, my little Obake-kun? *(laughs)* You should focus on what he put you through instead.
Hey. You knew the champ?
Oh, you mean Hammond? Yes, we were friends on a Lunar Colony!
Hm. Not what he said.
Since you're handling Mizuki, now... you should know that his performance will suffer if he's coddled.
I don't need him to 'perform'. Overwatch isn't a circus.
Oh? *(giggles)* You could have fooled me.
Genji made a strong case for you, recruit. Don't let him down.
I won't. Not when you're all giving me another chance at life.
You and ol' Mako seem to be having a good time out here. Enjoying the pachimaris?
That we are! The sound of those sweet little onions are a sonorific symphony to my eardrums!
Like when you squeeze 'em?
No! Like when we bomb the whole machine!
It's nice having so many friendly faces around. I'm so used to training on my own.
That sounds just like my life before MEKA. Sweating it out at the PC bang!
Weren't you just... gaming?
Hey! eSports are still sports!
Papa! Have you seen a delivery of cat litter? I've been looking all over!
You mean the clumping, low-dust, moisture-absorbing sand? It was perfect for cleaning up those pesky oil stains!
Papa!
*(chuckle)* I'm joking. I'll keep an eye out for it.
*(sigh)* Deadlock's really tearin' a path across the west, these days.
**western whistle**
Appreciate the enthusiasm, Bastion... but I don't think I'm the right man to stop 'em.
That new blade is rather bold, darling. Designed to terrify, is it?
Of course. I always like to leave a lasting impression.
Life's been too easy lately. Maybe I ought to give your bounty a try.
*(snort)* Good luck with that.
Thank you for lending us your aid, Commander. Let us sit down for tea the next time you visit.
I'll take you up on that. As long as we go somewhere that does the roasted stuff.
Our little vacation's comin' up boys. Don't make me regret bringin' ya.
We'd never, my Queen! I'll cover every grain of sand with explosives!
Boom.
*(groan)* Bloody idiots.
Do not forget our terms. I won't allow your recklessness to ruin my plans.
You doubtin' me, lady? *(laughs)* I made a kingdom out of wreckage.
And wreckage suits you. Just don't burn down what I've built.
If the pot was sweet enough... I might be willing to serve you, madam wolf.
I have no use for the allegiance of one so willing to betray his leaders.
Who said anything about betrayal? I was only talking about teams. Mercenaries!
You did some good work against the Hashimoto out there.
Thanks. Didn't hurt having Commander Chase backing me up.
Well, if you ever want to take that fox sightseeing, you'd be welcome in Overwatch.
Nice of you to offer, but... I think I'm right where I want to be.
Reckon Busan's in need of a little fireworks show!
The only firework show you see will be my missiles blowing up in your face!
Kinda nice not being the new kid anymore, huh?
**disgruntled beeps**
I wasn't calling you a kid... wait, how old are you?
Will you lot stop blasting my ship? You're bein' a real pain in my kidneys!
We'll stop 'blasting your ship' when you stop invading Busan!
Well that's no fair at all!
Gibraltar won't be the same without you, Genji.
Overwatch will still be formidable in my absence.
Oh, I don't care about that. Just gonna miss having someone else who oils their own joints
(chuckle) Hopefully my replacement will fill that role, too
I recall you swearing you would never return home. You have come far, leaving that resentment behind.
Just as you taught me, forgiveness is a form of peace. Now, I choose to live each day in pursuit of it.
You think MEKA is going to let you take the EMP bomb without a fight?
I welcome your resistance... though I doubt your forces will be a challenge for mine.
Claudio and Hector send their condolences. They know what Gibraltar meant to Overwatch.
*(sigh)* Well, when they're done feeling sorry, they could help us put this place back together!
I'll give them a nudge
We already miss you, Genji. I'll be here if you ever need a training partner to knock some more sense into you!
I'd gladly call on you for friendship. As for the bruises... I will manage without.
Where did a medic like you learn to handle a weapon like that?
The number of battlefields I've seen, I was bound to pick something up.
Baptiste, was it? How did a mercenary like yourself come by such advanced technologies?
Oh, I just make use of what I find lying around.
I wish we could get that Immortality Field to work on my turret.
But then our enemies would have no chance!
You kids today with your techno music. You should enjoy the classics, like Hasselhoff!
Oh, man, I can't even take you seriously right now.
Why am I not surprised to learn that you grew up in a place like this, McCree?
lines.modernSubtitles: Why am I not surprised to learn that you grew up in a place like this?

lines.subtitles: I'm from Texas.
It's me! Someone must be hacking.
I hope we don't get banned for this.
Seeing what happened after the war here gives me hope for the rebuilding of my country.
Whoa, it's me! Is my chronal accelerator malfunctioning again?
Wait. That's what I was just thinking. Spooky.
Nope, I know how that feels. This is something else entirely.
